English: For they are wholly given to me from among the children of Israel; instead of all who open the womb, even the firstborn of all the children of Israel, I have taken them to me.

Kikuyu: Irigithathi o rĩothe rĩa njamba gũkũ Isiraeli, kana nĩ rĩa mũndũ kana nĩ rĩa nyamũ-rĩ, nĩ rĩakwa. Rĩrĩa ndooragire marigithathi mothe kũu bũrũri wa Misiri-rĩ, hĩndĩ ĩyo nĩguo ndaamaamũrire matuĩke akwa mwene.
English: For all the firstborn among the children of Israel are mine, both man and animal. On the day that I struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, I sanctified them for myself.

Kikuyu: Na niĩ nĩ njoete Alawii ithenya rĩa marigithathi mothe ma ciana cia tũhĩĩ thĩinĩ wa Isiraeli.
English: I have taken the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel.

Kikuyu: Thĩinĩ wa andũ a Isiraeli othe-rĩ, nĩheanĩte Alawii matuĩke iheo kũrĩ Harũni na ariũ ake, na marutage wĩra Hema-inĩ-ĩno-ya-Gũtũnganwo handũ ha andũ a Isiraeli, na mamahorohagĩrie nĩgeetha andũ a Isiraeli matikae kũniinwo na mũthiro hĩndĩ ĩrĩa mangĩkuhĩrĩria handũ-harĩa-haamũre.”
English: I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the Tent of Meeting, and to make atonement for the children of Israel, so that there will be no plague among the children of Israel when the children of Israel come near to the sanctuary.”

Kikuyu: Musa, na Harũni marĩ na kĩrĩndĩ kĩu gĩothe kĩa andũ a Isiraeli magĩĩka Alawii o ta ũguo Jehova aathĩte Musa.
English: Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel did so to the Levites. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so the children of Israel did to them.

Kikuyu: Alawii acio magĩĩtheria na magĩthambia nguo ciao. Harũni nake agĩcooka akĩmaruta ta igongona rĩa gũthũngũthio mbere ya Jehova, na akĩmahoroheria nĩguo amatherie.
English: The Levites purified themselves from sin, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them for a wave offering before Yahweh and Aaron made atonement for them to cleanse them.

Kikuyu: Thuutha ũcio, Alawii magĩtoonya Hema-inĩ-ĩyo-ya-Gũtũnganwo marutage wĩra wao marũgamĩrĩirwo nĩ Harũni na ariũ ake. Magĩĩka Alawii acio o ta ũrĩa Jehova aathĩte Musa gwĩkwo.
English: After that, the Levites went in to do their service in the Tent of Meeting before Aaron and before his sons: as Yahweh had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so they did to them.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ,
English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

Kikuyu: “Ũndũ ũyũ nĩguo ũkoniĩ Alawii: Atĩrĩ, arũme othe arĩa mahingĩtie mĩaka mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na ĩtano na makĩria nĩo marĩũkaga kũruta wĩra Hema-inĩ-ya- Gũtũnganwo,
English: “This is what is assigned to the Levites: from twenty-five years old and upward they shall go in to wait on the service in the work of the Tent of Meeting;

Kikuyu: no mahingia mĩaka mĩrongo ĩtano-rĩ, no nginya mahurũke kuuma wĩra ũcio wao wa gũtungata, matigacooke kũruta wĩra.
English: and from the age of fifty years they shall retire from doing the work, and shall serve no more,

Kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, no mateithagĩrĩrie ariũ a ithe wao rĩrĩa mekũruta wĩra Hema-inĩ-ya-Gũtũnganwo, no-o ene matikarute wĩra ũcio. Ũguo nĩguo ũrĩgayagĩra Alawii wĩra ũrĩa marĩrutaga.”
English: but shall assist their brothers in the Tent of Meeting, to perform the duty, and shall perform no service. This is how you shall have the Levites do their duties.”

Kikuyu: Nake Jehova akĩarĩria Musa kũu Werũ-inĩ wa Sinai mweri-inĩ wa mbere wa mwaka wa keerĩ thu- utha wa andũ a Isiraeli kuuma bũrũri wa Misiri, akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ,
English: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

Kikuyu: “Ĩra andũ a Isiraeli makũngũyagĩre Gĩathĩ-kĩa-Bathaka ihinda rĩrĩa rĩtuĩtwo.
English: “Let the children of Israel keep the Passover in its appointed season.

Kikuyu: Kũngũyagĩrai gĩathĩ kĩu ihinda rĩrĩa rĩtuĩtwo, hwaĩ-inĩ wa mũthenya wa ikũmi na ĩna wa mweri ũyũ, kũringana na mawatho makĩo mothe na mũtabarĩre wakĩo.”
English: On the fourteenth day of this month, at evening, you shall keep it in its appointed season. You shall keep it according to all its statutes and according to all its ordinances.”

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Musa akĩĩra andũ a Isiraeli makũngũĩre Gĩathĩ-kĩa-Bathaka.
English: Moses told the children of Israel that they should keep the Passover.

Kikuyu: Nao magĩĩka o ro ũguo kũu Werũ-inĩ wa Sinai hwaĩ-inĩ wa mũthenya wa ikũmi na ĩna wa mweri wa mbere. Andũ a Isiraeli magĩĩka maũndũ mothe o ta ũrĩa Jehova aathĩte Musa.
English: They kept the Passover in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at evening, in the wilderness of Sinai. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did.

Kikuyu: No amwe ao matingĩakũngũĩire Gĩathĩ-kĩa-Bathaka mũthenya ũcio nĩ ũndũ nĩmagwatĩtwo nĩ thaahu nĩ ũndũ wa kũhutania na kĩimba kĩa mũndũ. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio magĩũka kũrĩ Musa na Harũni mũthenya o ro ũcio
English: There were certain men who were unclean because of the dead body of a man, so that they could not keep the Passover on that day, and they came before Moses and Aaron on that day.

Kikuyu: makĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ, “Nĩ tũnyiitĩtwo nĩ thaahu nĩ ũndũ wa kũhutania na kĩimba kĩa mũndũ, no nĩ kĩĩ gĩgũtũma tũgirio kũneana indo cia kũrutĩra Jehova tũrĩ hamwe na andũ a Isiraeli arĩa angĩ ihinda rĩrĩa rĩtuĩtwo?”
English: Those men said to him, “We are unclean because of the dead body of a man. Why are we kept back, that we may not offer the offering of Yahweh in its appointed season among the children of Israel?”

Kikuyu: Musa akĩmacookeria atĩrĩ, “Etererai nyambe nduĩrie ũhoro wa ũrĩa Jehova egwathana ũhoro wanyu.”
English: Moses answered them, “Wait, that I may hear what Yahweh will command concerning you.”

Kikuyu: Jehova agĩcooka akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ,
English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

Kikuyu: “Ĩra andũ a Isiraeli atĩrĩ: ‘Rĩrĩa mũndũ wanyu o na ũrĩkũ kana njiaro cianyu marĩ na thaahu nĩ ũndũ wa kũhutania na kĩimba kĩa mũndũ, kana akorwo arĩ rũgendo-inĩ-rĩ, mũndũ ũcio o nake no akũngũĩre Gĩathĩ-kĩa-Bathaka ya Jehova.
English: “Say to the children of Israel, ‘If any man of you or of your generations is unclean by reason of a dead body, or is on a journey far away, he shall still keep the Passover to Yahweh.

Kikuyu: Marĩkũngũyagĩra gĩathĩ kĩu hwaĩ-inĩ wa mũthenya wa ikũmi na ĩna wa mweri wa keerĩ. Marĩrĩĩaga gatũrũme na mĩgate ĩtarĩ mĩĩkĩre ndawa ya kũimbia na nyeni ndũrũ.
English: In the second month, on the fourteenth day at evening they shall keep it; they shall eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.

Kikuyu: Matikanatigie gacunjĩ o na kamwe karaare nginya rũciinĩ kana moine ihĩndĩ rĩako o na rĩmwe. Rĩrĩa megũkũngũĩra Gĩathĩ-kĩa-Bathaka ĩyo no nginya marũmagĩrĩre mũtabarĩre wakĩo wothe.
English: They shall leave none of it until the morning, nor break a bone of it. According to all the statute of the Passover they shall keep it.

Kikuyu: No mũndũ angĩkorwo ndarĩ na thaahu, na ndathiĩte rũgendo, na aage gũkũngũĩra Gĩathĩ-kĩa-Bathaka, mũndũ ũcio nĩakaingatwo athengio kuuma kũrĩ andũ ao, nĩ ũndũ ndaareheire Jehova indo iria arutagĩrwo ihinda rĩrĩa rĩtuĩtwo. Mũndũ ũcio nĩagacookererwo nĩ mehia make mwene.
English: But the man who is clean, and is not on a journey, and fails to keep the Passover, that soul shall be cut off from his people. Because he didn’t offer the offering of Yahweh in its appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.

Kikuyu: “ ‘Mũgeni ũikaranĩtie na inyuĩ na ende gũkũngũĩra Gĩathĩ-kĩa-Bathaka ya Jehova-rĩ, no nginya eke ũguo kũringana na watho na mũtabarĩre wakĩo. No nginya mũgĩage na mĩtabarĩre ya mũthemba ũmwe kũrĩ mũgeni na kũrĩ mũndũ ũrĩa ũciarĩirwo bũrũri wanyu.’ ”
English: “ ‘If a foreigner lives among you and desires to keep the Passover to Yahweh, then he shall do so according to the statute of the Passover, and according to its ordinance. You shall have one statute, both for the foreigner and for him who is born in the land.’ ”

Kikuyu: Mũthenya ũrĩa Hema-ĩrĩa-Nyamũre, o Hema-ĩyo-ya-Ũira yaambirwo-rĩ, itu rĩkĩmĩhumbĩra. Kuuma hwaĩ-inĩ nginya rũciinĩ itu rĩu rĩarĩ igũrũ rĩa Hema-ĩyo-Nyamũre na itu rĩu rĩkoonagwo rĩhaana ta mwaki.
English: On the day that the tabernacle was raised up, the cloud covered the tabernacle, even the Tent of the Testimony. At evening it was over the tabernacle, as it were the appearance of fire, until morning.

Kikuyu: Ũguo nĩguo gwathiire na mbere gũikara; itu rĩkamĩhumbĩra ũtukũ na rĩkoonagwo rĩhaana ta mwaki.
English: So it was continually. The cloud covered it, and the appearance of fire by night.

Kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa yothe itu rĩu rĩeheraga kuuma harĩ hema ĩyo, andũ a Isiraeli makoimagara magathiĩ; na rĩrĩ, itu rĩu rĩarũgamĩra handũ, andũ a Isiraeli makaamba hema ciao ho.
English: Whenever the cloud was taken up from over the Tent, then after that the children of Israel traveled; and in the place where the cloud remained, there the children of Israel encamped.

Kikuyu: Jehova aathana-rĩ, andũ a Isiraeli makoimagara magathiĩ, na aathana rĩngĩ makaamba hema ciao. Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa yothe itu rĩu rĩaikara igũrũ rĩa Hema-ĩyo-Nyamũre, maikaraga o hau kambĩ.
English: At the commandment of Yahweh, the children of Israel traveled, and at the commandment of Yahweh they encamped. As long as the cloud remained on the tabernacle they remained encamped.

Kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa itu rĩaikara igũrũ rĩa Hema-ĩyo-Nyamũre kahinda karaaya-rĩ, andũ a Isiraeli magaathĩkĩra Jehova na makaaga kuumagara.
English: When the cloud stayed on the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept Yahweh’s command, and didn’t travel.

Kikuyu: Mahinda mamwe itu rĩu rĩaikaraga igũrũ rĩa Hema-ĩyo-Nyamũre o matukũ manini; no Jehova aathana makaamba hema, na ningĩ aathana, makoimagara magathiĩ.
English: Sometimes the cloud was a few days on the tabernacle; then according to the commandment of Yahweh they remained encamped, and according to the commandment of Yahweh they traveled.

Kikuyu: Mahinda mamwe itu rĩu rĩaikaraga o kuuma hwaĩ-inĩ nginya rũciinĩ, na itu rĩehera rũciinĩ- rĩ, makoimagara magathiĩ. Kana nĩ mũthenya kana nĩ ũtukũ, hĩndĩ o yothe itu rĩu rĩehera nao makoimagara magathiĩ.
English: Sometimes the cloud was from evening until morning; and when the cloud was taken up in the morning, they traveled; or by day and by night, when the cloud was taken up, they traveled.

Kikuyu: Itu rĩu rĩngĩaikarire igũrũ rĩa hema ĩyo mĩthenya ĩĩrĩ, kana mweri, kana mwaka, andũ a Isiraeli maikaraga kũu kambĩ, na matingĩoimagarire mathiĩ, no itu rĩu rĩehera makoimagara magathiĩ.
English: Whether it was two days, or a month, or a year that the cloud stayed on the tabernacle, remaining on it, the children of Israel remained encamped, and didn’t travel; but when it was taken up, they traveled.

Kikuyu: Jehova aathana makaamba hema, na ningĩ Jehova aathana makoimagara magathiĩ. Maathĩkagĩra watho wa Jehova kũringana na ũrĩa aathaga Musa.
English: At the commandment of Yahweh they encamped, and at the commandment of Yahweh they traveled. They kept Yahweh’s command, at the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.

Kikuyu: Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ:
English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

Kikuyu: “Thondeka tũrumbeta twĩrĩ, ũtũthondeke na betha ndure, tũhũthagĩrwo gwĩtaga kĩrĩndĩ hamwe, o na twa gwĩta andũ moime kambĩ moimagare mathiĩ.
English: “Make two trumpets of silver. You shall make them of beaten work. You shall use them for the calling of the congregation and for the journeying of the camps.

Kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa tũrumbeta tweerĩ twahuhwo hamwe, kĩrĩndĩ gĩothe gĩkongana harĩwe hau itoonyero-inĩ rĩa Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo.
English: When they blow them, all the congregation shall gather themselves to you at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

Kikuyu: Angĩkorwo no karumbeta kamwe kahuhwo-rĩ, atongoria, nĩo anene a mbarĩ cia Isiraeli, nĩo marĩũnganaga harĩwe.
English: If they blow just one, then the princes, the heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves to you.

Kikuyu: Rĩrĩa karumbeta kahuhwo na mũgambo mũnene, mĩhĩrĩga ĩrĩa ĩikarĩte mwena wa irathĩro ĩkoimagara.
English: When you blow an alarm, the camps that lie on the east side shall go forward.

Kikuyu: Karumbeta ga keerĩ kahuhwo na mũgambo mũnene, andũ a kambĩ cia mwena wa gũthini makoimagara. Mũgambo ũcio mũnene nĩguo kĩmenyithia gĩa kuumagara.
English: When you blow an alarm the second time, the camps that lie on the south side shall go forward. They shall blow an alarm for their journeys.

Kikuyu: Nĩgeetha kĩrĩndĩ kĩũngane-rĩ, huhagai tũrumbeta, no ti na mĩhuhĩre ta ĩyo ĩngĩ.
English: But when the assembly is to be gathered together, you shall blow, but you shall not sound an alarm.

Kikuyu: “Ariũ a Harũni, acio athĩnjĩri-Ngai, nĩo marĩhuhaga tũrumbeta tũu. Ũndũ ũcio ũtuĩke watho wa gũtũũrionĩinyuĩnanjiarwairiaigooka.
English: “The sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow the trumpets. This shall be to you for a statute forever throughout your generations.

Kikuyu: Rĩrĩamũgũthiĩmbaaraĩrĩbũrũriwanyukĩũmbemũkarũena thũ iria imũhinyagĩrĩria-rĩ, huhagai tũrumbeta na mũgambo mũnene. Hĩndĩ ĩyo Jehova Ngai wanyu nĩakamũririkana na amũhonokie kuuma kũrĩ thũ cianyu.
English: When you go to war in your land against the adversary who oppresses you, then you shall sound an alarm with the trumpets. Then you will be remembered before Yahweh your God, and you will be saved from your enemies.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ mahinda manyu ma gũkena, nĩmo ma ciathĩ cianyu iria njathane, na ciathĩ cia Karũgamo ka Mweri, nĩ mũrĩhuhaga tũrumbeta nĩ ũndũ wa maruta ma njino na maruta ma ũiguano, na nĩmo magaatuĩka kĩririkano kĩanyu mbere ya Ngai wanyu. Niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova Ngai Wanyu.”
English: “Also in the day of your gladness, and in your set feasts, and in the beginnings of your months, you shall blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; and they shall be to you for a memorial before your God. I am Yahweh your God.”

Kikuyu: Mũthenya wa mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ wa mweri wa keerĩ mwaka-inĩ wa ĩĩrĩ, itu nĩrĩeherire kuuma hema-inĩ ĩrĩa nyamũre ya Ũira.
English: In the second year, in the second month, on the twentieth day of the month, the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle of the covenant.

Kikuyu: Nao andũ a Isiraeli makiumagara kuuma Werũ wa Sinai magĩthiĩ kuuma handũ hamwe nginya harĩa hangĩ, o nginya rĩrĩa itu rĩu rĩarũgamire Werũ-inĩ wa Parani.
English: The children of Israel went forward on their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud stayed in the wilderness of Paran.

Kikuyu: Nao makiumagara, arĩ riita rĩa mbere, o ta ũrĩa Jehova aathĩte Musa.
English: They first went forward according to the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.

Kikuyu: Ikundi cia kambĩ ya Juda nĩcio cioimagarire mbere, irũmĩrĩire bendera yao. Nake Nahashoni mũrũ wa Aminadabu nĩwe warĩ mũtongoria wao.
English: First, the standard of the camp of the children of Judah went forward according to their armies. Nahshon the son of Amminadab was over his army.

Kikuyu: Nethaneli mũrũ wa Zuaru nĩwe warĩ mũtongoria wa gĩkundi kĩa mũhĩrĩga wa Isakaru,
English: Nethanel the son of Zuar was over the army of the tribe of the children of Issachar.

Kikuyu: nake Eliabu mũrũ wa Heloni nĩwe warĩ mũtongoria wa gĩkundi kĩa mũhĩrĩga wa Zebuluni.
English: Eliab the son of Helon was over the army of the tribe of the children of Zebulun.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ Hema-ĩrĩa-Nyamũre ĩkĩambũrwo, nao Agerishoni na Amerari, arĩa maamĩkuuaga, makiumagara.
English: The tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari, who bore the tabernacle, went forward.

Kikuyu: Nacio ikundi cia kambĩ ya Rubeni ikĩrũmĩrĩra ikundi cia Juda, irũmĩrĩire bendera yao. Elizuru mũrũ wa Shedeuru nĩwe warĩ mũtongoria wao.
English: The standard of the camp of Reuben went forward according to their armies. Elizur the son of Shedeur was over his army.

Kikuyu: Shelumieli mũrũ wa Zurishadai nĩwe warĩ mũtongoria wa gĩkundi kĩa mũhĩrĩga wa Simeoni,
English: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai was over the army of the tribe of the children of Simeon.

Kikuyu: nake Eliasafu mũrũ wa Deueli nĩwe warĩ mũtongoria wa gĩkundi kĩa mũhĩrĩga wa Gadi.
English: Eliasaph the son of Deuel was over the army of the tribe of the children of Gad.

Kikuyu: Nao Akohathu makiumagara makuuĩte indo iria nyamũre. Hema-ĩrĩa-Nyamũre yarĩ ĩkorwo yaambĩtwo matanakinya.
English: The Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary. The others set up the tabernacle before they arrived.

Kikuyu: Nacio ikundi cia kambĩ ya Efiraimu ikĩrũmĩrĩra ikundi cia Rubeni, irũmĩrĩire bendera yao. Elishama mũrũ wa Amihudu nĩwe warĩ mũtongoria wao.
English: The standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies. Elishama the son of Ammihud was over his army.

Kikuyu: Gamalieli mũrũ wa Pedazuru nĩwe warĩ mũtongoria wa gĩkundi kĩa mũhĩrĩga wa Manase,
English: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur was over the army of the tribe of the children of Manasseh.

Kikuyu: nake Abidani mũrũ wa Gideoni nĩwe warĩ mũtongoria wa gĩkundi kĩa mũhĩrĩga wa Benjamini.
English: Abidan the son of Gideoni was over the army of the tribe of the children of Benjamin.

Kikuyu: Kũrigĩrĩria-rĩ, ikundi cia kambĩ ya Dani ikiumagara irĩ thuutha wa icio ingĩ ciothe, ikiumagara ĩrũmĩrĩire bendera yao. Ahiezeri mũrũ wa Amishadai nĩwe warĩ mũtongoria wao.
English: The standard of the camp of the children of Dan, which was the rear guard of all the camps, set forward according to their armies. Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai was over his army.

Kikuyu: Pagieli mũrũ wa Okirani nĩwe watongoragia gĩkundi kĩa mũhĩrĩga wa Asheri,
English: Pagiel the son of Ochran was over the army of the tribe of the children of Asher.

Kikuyu: nake Ahira mũrũ wa Enani nĩwe watongoragia gĩkundi kĩa mũhĩrĩga wa Nafitali.
English: Ahira the son of Enan was over the army of the tribe of the children of Naphtali.

Kikuyu: Ũguo nĩguo ikundi cia andũ a Isiraeli ciarũmanĩrĩire ikiumagara.
English: Thus were the travels of the children of Israel according to their armies; and they went forward.

Kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, Musa akĩĩra Hobabu mũrũ wa Reueli ũrĩa Mũmidiani ũrĩa warĩ mũthoni-we atĩrĩ, “Nĩtũroimagara tũthiĩ kũrĩa Jehova aatwĩrire ũhoro wakuo atĩrĩ, ‘Nĩngamũhe kũndũ kũu.’ Ũka tũthiĩ nawe, na nĩtũgũgwĩka maũndũ mega, nĩ ũndũ Jehova nĩerĩire Isiraeli maũndũ mega.”
English: Moses said to Hobab, the son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses’ father-in-law, “We are journeying to the place of which Yahweh said, ‘I will give it to you.’ Come with us, and we will treat you well; for Yahweh has spoken good concerning Israel.”

Kikuyu: Hobabu akĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Aca, ndigũũka; no ngũcooka bũrũri witũ na kũrĩ andũ aitũ.”
English: He said to him, “I will not go; but I will depart to my own land, and to my relatives.”

Kikuyu: No Musa akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Ndagũthaitha ndũgatũtige. Wee nĩũũĩ kũndũ kũrĩa tũngĩamba hema ciitũ gũkũ werũ-inĩ, na no ũtuĩke maitho maitũ.
English: Moses said, “Don’t leave us, please; because you know how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and you can be our eyes.

Kikuyu: Ũngĩtwarana na ithuĩ-rĩ, nĩtũrĩkũgayagĩra kĩrĩa gĩothe kĩega Jehova arĩtũheaga.”
English: It shall be, if you go with us—yes, it shall be—that whatever good Yahweh does to us, we will do the same to you.”

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio makiumagara moimĩte hau kĩrĩma-inĩ kĩa Jehova, magĩthiĩ rũgendo rwa mĩthenya ĩtatũ. Narĩo ithandũkũ rĩa kĩrĩkanĩro kĩa Jehova rĩgĩthiĩ rĩmatongoretie mĩthenya ĩyo ĩtatũ, nĩguo rĩkamacarĩrie handũ ha kũhurũka.
English: They set forward from the Mount of Yahweh three days’ journey. The ark of Yahweh’s covenant went before them three days’ journey, to seek out a resting place for them.

Kikuyu: Narĩo itu rĩa Jehova rĩakoragwo igũrũ rĩao o mũthenya makiumagara kuuma kambĩ.
English: The cloud of Yahweh was over them by day, when they set forward from the camp.

Kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa yothe ithandũkũ rĩoimagario, Musa akoiga atĩrĩ, “Jehova, arahũka! Thũ ciaku irohurunjũka; thũ ciaku irokũũrĩra.”
English: When the ark went forward, Moses said, “Rise up, Yahweh, and let your enemies be scattered! Let those who hate you flee before you!”

Kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa rĩaigwo thĩ, akoiga atĩrĩ, “Jehova cookerera ngiri ici cia Isiraeli itangĩtarĩka.”
English: When it rested, he said, “Return, Yahweh, to the ten thousands of the thousands of Israel.”

Kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, andũ a Isiraeli magĩteta nĩ ũndũ wa moritũ mao, nakuo gũteta kwao gũkĩiguuo nĩ Jehova, na rĩrĩa aamaiguire, agĩakanwo nĩ marakara, naguo mwaki ũkiuma kũrĩ Jehova, ũgĩakana gatagatĩ kao, na ũgĩcina ndeere imwe cia kambĩ.
English: The people were complaining in the ears of Yahweh. When Yahweh heard it, his anger burned; and Yahweh’s fire burned among them, and consumed some of the outskirts of the camp.

Kikuyu: Rĩrĩa andũ acio maakaĩire Musa, Musa akĩhooya Jehova, naguo mwaki ũcio ũkĩhora.
English: The people cried to Moses; and Moses prayed to Yahweh, and the fire abated.

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio handũ hau hagĩĩtwo Tabera, tondũ mwaki ũcio woimĩte kũrĩ Jehova nĩwakanĩte gatagatĩ kao.
English: The name of that place was called Taberah,† because Yahweh’s fire burned among them.

Kikuyu: Kĩrĩndĩ kĩrĩa kĩarũmanĩrĩire nao makiuma bũrũri wa Misiri gĩkĩambĩrĩria kwĩrirĩria irio cia mĩthemba ĩngĩ, na o rĩngĩ andũ a Isiraeli makĩambĩrĩria kũrĩra, makiuga atĩrĩ, “Naarĩ korwo tũrĩ na nyama cia kũrĩa!
English: The mixed multitude that was among them lusted exceedingly; and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, “Who will give us meat to eat?

Kikuyu: Nĩtũkũririkana thamaki iria twarĩĩaga kũu bũrũri wa Misiri tũtekũgũra, o na marenge ma mĩthemba mĩthemba, na itũngũrũ cia mahuti, na itũngũrũ iria ndungu, o na itũngũrũ thumu.
English: We remember the fish, which we ate in Egypt for nothing; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlic;

Kikuyu: No rĩu, tũtirĩ na wendo wa kũrĩa; na tũtirĩ kĩndũ o nakĩ tuonaga, tiga o mana maya moiki!”
English: but now we have lost our appetite. There is nothing at all except this manna to look at.”

Kikuyu: Mana macio maahaanaga ta mbegũ cia mũtĩ ũrĩa wĩtagwo korianda, na mũhianĩre wamo watariĩ ta bedola.
English: The manna was like coriander seed, and it looked like bdellium.‡

Kikuyu: Andũ maathiiaga makamongania, magacooka makamathĩa na gĩthĩi kĩa moko, kana makamahũrĩra ndĩrĩ-inĩ na mũũthĩ. Maamarugaga na nyũngũ kana magathondeka tũmĩgate. Na maacamaga ta kĩndũ gĩthondeketwo na maguta ma mũtamaiyũ.
English: The people went around, gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in mortars, and boiled it in pots, and made cakes of it. Its taste was like the taste of fresh oil.

Kikuyu: Rĩrĩa kwagĩa ime ũtukũ kũu kambĩ- inĩ, mana macio makagũanĩra narĩo.
English: When the dew fell on the camp in the night, the manna fell on it.

Kikuyu: Musa nĩaiguire andũ a nyũmba ciothe makĩrĩra, o mũndũ arĩ mũromo-inĩ wa hema yake. Nake Jehovanĩarakariremũnomakĩria, naMusaagĩthĩĩnĩka.
English: Moses heard the people weeping throughout their families, every man at the door of his tent; and Yahweh’s anger burned greatly; and Moses was displeased.

Kikuyu: AkĩũriaJehovaatĩrĩ, “Nĩkĩĩgĩtũmĩteũrehere ndungata yaku thĩĩna ũyũ? Nĩ atĩa njĩkĩte ũkaaga gũgũkenia nĩguo ũnjigĩrĩre mũrigo wa andũ aya othe?
English: Moses said to Yahweh, “Why have you treated your servant so badly? Why haven’t I found favor in your sight, that you lay the burden of all this people on me?

Kikuyu: Kaĩ arĩ niĩ ithe wao? Kaĩ arĩ niĩ ndaamaciarire? Nĩ kĩĩ kĩratũma ũnjĩĩre ndĩmakuue na moko makwa, ta ũrĩa mũreri wa mwana akuuaga kaana ka rũkenge, ndĩmatware bũrũri ũrĩa werĩire maithe mao ma tene na mwĩhĩtwa?
English: Have I conceived all this people? Have I brought them out, that you should tell me, ‘Carry them in your bosom, as a nurse carries a nursing infant, to the land which you swore to their fathers’?

Kikuyu: Ingĩruta nyama cia kũhe andũ aya othe kũ? Marandĩrĩra makiugaga atĩrĩ, ‘Tũhe nyama tũrĩe!’
English: Where could I get meat to give all these people? For they weep before me, saying, ‘Give us meat, that we may eat.’

Kikuyu: Ndingĩhota gũkuua andũ aya othe ndĩ nyiki; mũrigo ũyũ nĩ mũritũ mũno kũrĩ niĩ.
English: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.

Kikuyu: Angĩkorwo ũguo nĩguo ũkũnjĩka-rĩ, njũraga o ro rĩu, angĩkorwo nĩnjĩtĩkĩrĩkĩte nĩwe, na ndũkareke nyone mwanangĩko wakwa mwene.”
English: If you treat me this way, please kill me right now, if I have found favor in your sight; and don’t let me see my wretchedness.”

Kikuyu: Nake Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ: “Ndehere athuuri mĩrongo mũgwanja a Isiraeli arĩa wee ũũĩ atĩ nĩ atongoria na anene thĩinĩ wa andũ aya. Ũmarehe Hema-inĩ-ya-Gũtũnganwo, nĩguo marũgame hau hamwe nawe.
English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Gather to me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom you know to be the elders of the people and officers over them; and bring them to the Tent of Meeting, that they may stand there with you.

Kikuyu: Niĩ na niĩ nĩngũikũrũka ngwarĩrie ho, njoe Roho ũrĩa ũrĩ naguo na ndĩmekĩre Roho ũcio. Nao nĩmarĩgũteithagia gũkuua mũrigo wa andũ aya nĩgeetha ndũkaũkuuage ũrĩ wiki.
English: I will come down and talk with you there. I will take of the Spirit which is on you, and will put it on them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with you, that you don’t bear it yourself alone.

Kikuyu: “Ningĩ wĩre andũ atĩrĩ, ‘Mwĩtheriei, mwĩhaarĩrie nĩ ũndũ wa rũciũ, rĩrĩa mũkaarĩa nyama. Jehova nĩaramũiguire rĩrĩa mũrarĩraga, mũkiugaga atĩrĩ, “Naarĩ korwo tũrĩ na nyama cia kũrĩa! Maũndũ maitũ maarĩ mega rĩrĩa twarĩ bũrũri wa Misiri!” Rĩu-rĩ, Jehova nĩekũmũhe nyama, na nĩmũgũcirĩa.
English: “Say to the people, ‘Sanctify yourselves in preparation for tomorrow, and you will eat meat; for you have wept in the ears of Yahweh, saying, “Who will give us meat to eat? For it was well with us in Egypt.” Therefore Yahweh will give you meat, and you will eat.

Kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, mũtigũcirĩa o mũthenya ũmwe, kana mĩthenya ĩĩrĩ, kana ĩtano, kana ikũmi, kana mĩthenya mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ,
English: You will not eat just one day, or two days, or five days, or ten days, or twenty days,

Kikuyu: no mũgũcirĩa mweri mũgima, o nginya ciume na maniũrũ manyu, na inyuĩ mũcinyire, nĩ ũndũ nĩmũregete Jehova ũrĩa ũrĩ hamwe na inyuĩ, na mũkarĩra mũrĩ mbere yake, mũkiugaga atĩrĩ, “Nĩ kĩĩ gĩatũmire tuume bũrũri wa Misiri?” ’ ”
English: but a whole month, until it comes out at your nostrils, and it is loathsome to you; because you have rejected Yahweh who is among you, and have wept before him, saying, “Why did we come out of Egypt?” ’ ”

Kikuyu: No Musa akĩĩra Jehova atĩrĩ, “Andũ arĩa ndĩ nao haha nĩ ngiri magana matandatũ arĩa maretwara na magũrũ, nawe woiga atĩ, ‘Nĩngũmahe nyama cia kũrĩa mweri mũgima!’
English: Moses said, “The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand men on foot; and you have said, ‘I will give them meat, that they may eat a whole month.’

Kikuyu: Andũ aya o na mangĩthĩnjĩrwo ndũũru cia mbũri na cia ngʼombe-rĩ, no imaigane? O na mangĩtegerwo thamaki ciothe cia iria-inĩ-rĩ, no imaigane?”
English: Shall flocks and herds be slaughtered for them, to be sufficient for them? Shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to be sufficient for them?”

Kikuyu: Jehova agĩcookeria Musa atĩrĩ, “Anga hinya wa guoko kwa Jehova nĩũnyiihĩte? Rĩu wee, nĩũkuona kana ũrĩa njugĩte nĩũkahingio kana ndũkahingio.”
English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Has Yahweh’s hand grown short? Now you will see whether my word will happen to you or not.”

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Musa akiuma nja, akĩĩra andũ acio ũrĩa Jehova oigĩte. Nake agĩcookanĩrĩria athuuri amwe ao mĩrongo mũgwanja, akĩmarũgamia marigiicĩirie Hema ĩyo.
English: Moses went out, and told the people Yahweh’s words; and he gathered seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them around the Tent.

Kikuyu: Nake Jehova agĩikũrũka na itu akĩaria na Musa, akĩoya Roho ũrĩa warĩ thĩinĩ wa Musa, na agĩĩkĩra Roho ũcio thĩinĩ wa athuuri acio mĩrongo mũgwanja. Rĩrĩa Roho okire igũrũ rĩao-rĩ, makĩratha mohoro, no matiacookire gwĩka ũguo hĩndĩ ĩngĩ.
English: Yahweh came down in the cloud, and spoke to him, and took of the Spirit that was on him, and put it on the seventy elders. When the Spirit rested on them, they prophesied, but they did so no more.

Kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, andũ eerĩ, nĩo Elidadi na Medadi, nĩmatigĩtwo kambĩ. Nao nĩmandĩkĩtwo hamwe na athuuri acio angĩ no matiathiĩte Hema-inĩ ĩyo. No rĩrĩ, Roho nĩ okire igũrũ rĩao, nao makĩratha mohoro marĩ kũu kambĩ.
English: But two men remained in the camp. The name of one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad; and the Spirit rested on them. They were of those who were written, but had not gone out to the Tent; and they prophesied in the camp.

Kikuyu: Mwanake ũmwe agĩtengʼera akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ, “Elidadi na Medadi nĩmararatha mohoro kũu kambĩ.”
English: A young man ran, and told Moses, and said, “Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp!”

Kikuyu: Joshua mũrũ wa Nuni, ũrĩa wateithagia Musa kuuma arĩ mũnini, akĩarĩria Musa, akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Musa, mwathi wakwa, makaanie!”
English: Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his chosen men, answered, “My lord Moses, forbid them!”

Kikuyu: No Musa akĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Kaĩ ũkũigua ũiru nĩ ũndũ wakwa? Niĩ ingĩenda andũ othe a Jehova makorwo marĩ anabii, na atĩ Jehova amekĩre Roho wake!”
English: Moses said to him, “Are you jealous for my sake? I wish that all Yahweh’s people were prophets, that Yahweh would put his Spirit on them!”

Kikuyu: Thuutha ũcio Musa na athuuri acio a Isiraeli magĩcooka kambĩ.
English: Moses went into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.

Kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, rũhuho rũkiuma harĩ Jehova, rũkĩrehe tũmakia-arũme kuuma iria-inĩ. Rũgĩtũgũithia tũthiũrũrũkĩirie mĩena yothe ya kambĩ buti ithatũ kuuma thĩ, handũ ha itĩĩna rĩa rũgendo rwa mũthenya mũgima mbarĩ ciothe.
English: A wind from Yahweh went out and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, about a day’s journey on this side, and a day’s journey on the other side, around the camp, and about two cubits§ above the surface of the earth.

Kikuyu: Mũthenya ũcio wothe na ũtukũ, na mũthenya ũcio ũngĩ wothe, andũ acio makiumagara makĩũngania tũmakia-arũme. Gũtirĩ mũndũ wonganirie thuutha wa homeri ikũmi.* Ningĩ magĩtwanĩka gũthiũrũrũkĩria kambĩ yothe.
English: The people rose up all that day, and all of that night, and all the next day, and gathered the quails. He who gathered least gathered ten homers;† and they spread them all out for themselves around the camp.

Kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, rĩrĩa nyama icio ciarĩ tũnua-inĩ twao, o na itarĩ ndanuke-rĩ, marakara ma Jehova magĩakanĩra andũ acio, akĩmahũũra na mũthiro mũnene.
English: While the meat was still between their teeth, before it was chewed, Yahweh’s anger burned against the people, and Yahweh struck the people with a very great plague.

Kikuyu: Tondũ ũcio handũ hau hagĩĩtwo Kibirothu-Hataava, nĩ ũndũ hau nĩho maathikire andũ arĩa maaiguĩte thuti ya irio ingĩ.
English: The name of that place was called Kibroth Hattaavah,‡ because there they buried the people who lusted.

Kikuyu: Kuuma Kibirothu-Hataava, andũ acio nĩmathiire rũgendo, magĩkinya Hazerothu, magĩikara kuo.
English: From Kibroth Hattaavah the people traveled to Hazeroth; and they stayed at Hazeroth.

Kikuyu: Nao Miriamu na Harũni magĩtetia Musa, nĩ ũndũ wa mũtumia wake Mũkushi, nĩgũkorwo Musa nĩ ahikĩtie Mũkushi.
English: Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had married; for he had married a Cushite woman.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ nao mooragia atĩrĩ, “Anga Jehova angĩaria o na Musa wiki? Githĩ o na ithuĩ to atwarĩrie?” Nake Jehova akĩigua ndeto icio.
English: They said, “Has Yahweh indeed spoken only with Moses? Hasn’t he spoken also with us?” And Yahweh heard it.

Kikuyu: (Na rĩrĩ, Musa aarĩ mũndũ mwĩnyiihia mũno, mwĩnyiihia gũkĩra andũ arĩa angĩ othe gũkũ thĩ).
English: Now the man Moses was very humble, more than all the men who were on the surface of the earth.

Kikuyu: O rĩmwe Jehova akĩĩra Musa na Harũni na Miriamu atĩrĩ, “Inyuĩ atatũ umai mũũke Hema-inĩ ĩyo- ya-Gũtũnganwo.” Nĩ ũndũ ũcio othe atatũ makiuma magĩthiĩ ho.
English: Yahweh spoke suddenly to Moses, to Aaron, and to Miriam, “You three come out to the Tent of Meeting!” The three of them came out.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ Jehova agĩikũrũka arĩ thĩinĩ wa gĩtugĩ gĩa itu, akĩrũgama itoonyero-inĩ rĩa Hema ĩyo, na agĩĩta Harũni na Miriamu. Na eerĩ magĩthiathia harĩ we,
English: Yahweh came down in a pillar of cloud, and stood at the door of the Tent, and called Aaron and Miriam; and they both came forward.

Kikuyu: nake akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Thikĩrĩriai ciugo ciakwa: “Rĩrĩa mũnabii wa Jehova arĩ gatagatĩ-inĩ kanyu-rĩ, niĩ nĩndĩĩmwĩguũragĩria na cioneki, na ngamwarĩria na irooto.
English: He said, “Now hear my words. If there is a prophet among you, I, Yahweh, will make myself known to him in a vision. I will speak with him in a dream.

Kikuyu: No ha ũhoro wa Musa ndungata yakwa ndiĩkaga ũguo; we nĩ mwĩhokeku thĩinĩ wa nyũmba yakwa yothe.
English: My servant Moses is not so. He is faithful in all my house.

Kikuyu: Musa-rĩ, twaranagĩria nake ũthiũ kwa ũthiũ, tũkaaranĩria ũhoro mũtaũku, na ndimwaragĩria na thimo; na nĩwe wonaga ũrĩa Jehova atariĩ. Nĩ kĩĩ kĩgiririe mwĩtigĩre gũtetia Musa ndungata yakwa?”
English: With him, I will speak mouth to mouth, even plainly, and not in riddles; and he shall see Yahweh’s form. Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant, against Moses?”

Kikuyu: Nake Jehova agĩcinwo nĩ marakara nĩ ũndũ wao, agĩthiĩ akĩmatiga.
English: Yahweh’s anger burned against them; and he departed.

Kikuyu: Rĩrĩa itu rĩu rĩeherire igũrũ rĩa Hema ĩyo, Miriamu agĩkorwo aarũgamĩte o ro hau, arĩ na mangũ, akerũha o ta ira. Nake Harũni ehũgũra akĩona atĩ Miriamu aarĩ na mangũ;
English: The cloud departed from over the Tent; and behold, Miriam was leprous, as white as snow. Aaron looked at Miriam, and behold, she was leprous.

Kikuyu: nake akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ, “Ndagũthaitha, mwathi wakwa, ndũgatũrũithĩrie wĩhia ũcio twĩkĩte na ũrimũ.
English: Aaron said to Moses, “Oh, my lord, please don’t count this sin against us, in which we have done foolishly, and in which we have sinned.

Kikuyu: Ndũkareke ahaane ta kĩhuno kiumĩte nda ya nyina mwĩrĩ wakĩo ũbuthĩte mwena ũmwe.”
English: Let her not, I pray, be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother’s womb.”

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Musa agĩkaĩra Jehova, akiuga atĩrĩ, “Wee Ngai, ndagũthaitha, mũhonie!”
English: Moses cried to Yahweh, saying, “Heal her, God, I beg you!”

Kikuyu: Nake Jehova agĩcookeria Musa, akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Korwo ithe nĩamũtuĩrĩire mata ũthiũ-rĩ, githĩ ndangĩaikarire na thoni matukũ mũgwanja? Mũhingĩrĩriei na kũu nja ya kambĩ matukũ mũgwanja; na thuutha ũcio no acookio kambĩ.”
English: Yahweh said to Moses, “If her father had but spit in her face, shouldn’t she be ashamed seven days? Let her be shut up outside of the camp seven days, and after that she shall be brought in again.”

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Miriamu akĩhingĩrĩrio na kũu nja ya kambĩ ĩyo matukũ mũgwanja, nao andũ acio angĩ matiathiire na mbere na rũgendo nginya rĩrĩa Miriamu aacookirio kambĩ.
English: Miriam was shut up outside of the camp seven days, and the people didn’t travel until Miriam was brought in again.

Kikuyu: Thuutha ũcio, andũ acio a Isiraeli makiuma Hazerothu magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao Werũ-inĩ wa Parani.
English: Afterward the people traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in the wilderness of Paran.

Kikuyu: Nake Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ,
English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

Kikuyu: “Tũma arũme amwe mathiĩ magathigaane bũrũri wa Kaanani, ũrĩa ngũhe andũ a Isiraeli. Tũma mũtongoria ũmwe wao, kuuma o mũhĩrĩga o mũhĩrĩga wa maithe mao.”
English: “Send men, that they may spy out the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel. Of every tribe of their fathers, you shall send a man, every one a prince among them.”

Kikuyu: Nake Musa agĩathĩkĩra watho wa Jehova, na agĩtũma andũ acio kuuma Werũ wa Parani. Andũ acio othe maarĩ atongoria a andũ a Isiraeli.
English: Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran according to the commandment of Yahweh. All of them were men who were heads of the children of Israel.

Kikuyu: Maya nĩmo marĩĩtwa ma atongoria acio: kuuma mũhĩrĩga wa Rubeni, aarĩ Shamua mũrũ wa Zakuri;
English: These were their names: Of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.

Kikuyu: kuuma mũhĩrĩga wa Simeoni, aarĩ Shafati mũrũ wa Hori;
English: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.

Kikuyu: kuuma mũhĩrĩga wa Juda, aarĩ Kalebu mũrũ wa Jefune;
English: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

Kikuyu: kuuma mũhĩrĩga wa Isakaru, aarĩ Igali mũrũ wa Jusufu;
English: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.

Kikuyu: kuuma mũhĩrĩga wa Efiraimu, aarĩ Hoshea mũrũ wa Nuni;
English: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Nun.

Kikuyu: kuuma mũhĩrĩga wa Benjamini, aarĩ Paliti mũrũ wa Rafu;
English: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.

Kikuyu: kuuma mũhĩrĩga wa Zebuluni, aarĩ Gadieli mũrũ wa Sodi;
English: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.

Kikuyu: kuuma mũhĩrĩga wa Manase (na nĩguo mũhĩrĩga wa Jusufu), aarĩ Gadi mũrũ wa Susi;
English: Of the tribe of Joseph, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.

Kikuyu: kuuma mũhĩrĩga wa Dani, aarĩ Amieli mũrũ wa Gemali;
English: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.

Kikuyu: kuuma mũhĩrĩga wa Asheri, aarĩ Sethuri mũrũ wa Mikaeli;
English: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.

Kikuyu: kuuma mũhĩrĩga wa Nafitali, aarĩ Nahabi mũrũ wa Vofisi;
English: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.

Kikuyu: kuuma mũhĩrĩga wa Gadi, aarĩ Geueli mũrũ wa Maki.
English: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.

Kikuyu: Macio nĩmo marĩĩtwa ma andũ arĩa Musa aatũmire magathigaane bũrũri ũcio. Nake Musa akĩgarũra rĩĩtwa rĩa Hoshea mũrũ wa Nuni akĩmũtua Joshua.
English: These are the names of the men who Moses sent to spy out the land. Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun Joshua.

Kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Musa aatũmire andũ acio magathigaane bũrũri wa Kaanani, aameerire atĩrĩ, “Ambatai mũtuĩkanĩrie Negevu, mũthiĩ bũrũri ũcio ũrĩ irĩma.
English: Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said to them, “Go up this way by the South, and go up into the hill country.

Kikuyu: Tuĩriai bũrũri ũcio ũrĩa ũtariĩ, muone kana andũ akuo marĩ na hinya kana matirĩ hinya, o na kana nĩ aingĩ kana nĩ anini.
English: See the land, what it is; and the people who dwell therein, whether they are strong or weak, whether they are few or many;

Kikuyu: Ningĩ mũmenye bũrũri ũcio matũũraga ũhaana atĩa? Nĩ mwega kana nĩ mũũru? Matũũraga matũũra ma mũthemba ũrĩkũ? Nĩ mairigĩre na thingo cia hinya kana ti mairigĩre?
English: and what the land is that they dwell in, whether it is good or bad; and what cities they are that they dwell in, whether in camps, or in strongholds;

Kikuyu: Tĩĩri wakuo ũtariĩ atĩa? Nĩ mũnoru kana nĩ mũhĩnju? Kũrĩ mĩtĩ kana gũtirĩ? Geriai mũno mũrehe maciaro mamwe ma bũrũri ũcio.” (Hĩndĩ ĩyo nĩguo mĩthabibũ yaambagĩrĩria kwĩrua.)
English: and what the land is, whether it is fertile or poor, whether there is wood therein, or not. Be courageous, and bring some of the fruit of the land.” Now the time was the time of the first-ripe grapes.

Kikuyu: Tondũ ũcio makĩambata magĩthigaana bũrũri ũcio kuuma Werũ wa Zini nginya Rehobu, merekeireLebo-Hamathu.
English: So they went up, and spied out the land from the wilderness of Zin to Rehob, to the entrance of Hamath.

Kikuyu: MambatirematuĩkanĩirieNegevunamagĩkinyaHebironikũrĩaAhimani, na Sheshai, na Talimai, njiaro cia Anaki, maatũũraga. (Itũũra rĩa Hebironi rĩakĩtwo mĩaka mũgwanja mbere ya itũũra rĩa Zoani gwakwo bũrũri-inĩ wa Misiri.)
English: They went up by the South, and came to Hebron; and Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were there. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)

Kikuyu: Rĩrĩa maakinyire Kĩanda gĩa Eshikoli, magĩtema rũhonge rwarĩ na kĩmanjĩka kĩmwe gĩa thabibũ. Andũ eerĩ ao makĩrũkuuanĩra na mũtĩ, hamwe na makomamanga mamwe, na ngũyũ.
English: They came to the valley of Eshcol, and cut down from there a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bore it on a staff between two. They also brought some of the pomegranates and figs.

Kikuyu: Naho handũ hau hagĩĩtwo Kĩanda gĩa Eshikoli nĩ ũndũ wa kĩmanjĩka kĩu gĩa thabibũ kĩrĩa andũ a Isiraeli acio maatemire ho.
English: That place was called the valley of Eshcol, because of the cluster which the children of Israel cut down from there.

Kikuyu: Matukũ mĩrongo ĩna mathira magĩcooka kuuma gũthigaana bũrũri ũcio.
English: They returned from spying out the land at the end of forty days.

Kikuyu: Nao magĩcooka kũrĩ Musa, na Harũni na kĩrĩndĩ gĩothe kĩa andũ a Isiraeli kũu Kadeshi o kũu Werũ-inĩ wa Parani. Kũu makĩhe Musa na Harũni, na kĩũngano gĩothe ũhoro ũcio na makĩmoonia maciaro ma bũrũri ũcio.
English: They went and came to Moses, to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, to the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word to them and to all the congregation. They showed them the fruit of the land.

Kikuyu: Makĩhe Musa ũhoro ũyũ: “Nĩtwatoonyire bũrũri ũrĩa watũtũmire, naguo nĩ bũrũri ũrĩ bũthi wa iria na ũũkĩ! Maya nĩmo maciaro maguo.
English: They told him, and said, “We came to the land where you sent us. Surely it flows with milk and honey, and this is its fruit.

Kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, andũ arĩa matũũraga kũu marĩ hinya, na matũũra mao nĩmairigĩre na thingo cia hinya, na nĩ manene mũno. O na ningĩ nĩtuonire njiaro cia Anaki kuo.
English: However, the people who dwell in the land are strong, and the cities are fortified and very large. Moreover, we saw the children of Anak there.

Kikuyu: Aamaleki matũũraga kũu Negevu; Ahiti, na Ajebusi, na Aamori matũũraga bũrũri ũrĩa ũrĩ irĩma; Akaanani nao matũũraga ndwere-inĩ cia iria na hũgũrũrũ-inĩ cia Rũũĩ rwa Jorodani.”
English: Amalek dwells in the land of the South. The Hittite, the Jebusite, and the Amorite dwell in the hill country. The Canaanite dwells by the sea, and along the side of the Jordan.”

Kikuyu: Nake Kalebu agĩkiria andũ acio o hau mbere ya Musa, akiuga atĩrĩ, “Nĩtwagĩrĩirwo nĩ kwambata tũthiĩ twĩnyiitĩre bũrũri ũcio, nĩ ũndũ no tũhote gwĩka ũguo.”
English: Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, “Let’s go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it!”

Kikuyu: No andũ arĩa maambatĩte nake makiuga atĩrĩ, “Tũtingĩtharĩkĩra andũ acio, marĩ na hinya gũtũkĩra.”
English: But the men who went up with him said, “We aren’t able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.”

Kikuyu: Nao makĩhunjia ũhoro mũũru kũrĩ andũ a Isiraeli ũkoniĩ bũrũri ũcio maathigaanĩte. Makiuga atĩrĩ, “Bũrũri ũcio tũrathigaanire nĩ bũrũri ũgũtambuura andũ arĩa matũũraga kuo ũkamaniina biũ. Andũ arĩa othe tuonire kuo nĩ anene mũno.
English: They brought up an evil report of the land which they had spied out to the children of Israel, saying, “The land, through which we have gone to spy it out, is a land that eats up its inhabitants; and all the people who we saw in it are men of great stature.

Kikuyu: Nĩtuonire Anefili kuo (njiaro cia Anaki, a kĩruka kĩa Anefili). Tweyonaga tũhaana ta ndaahi, o nao moonaga tũhaana o ta cio.”
English: There we saw the Nephilim,† the sons of Anak, who come from the Nephilim.‡ We were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.”

Kikuyu: Ũtukũ ũcio andũ othe a kĩrĩndĩ gĩa Isiraeli makĩrĩra maanĩrĩire na mũgambo mũnene.
English: All the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.

Kikuyu: Andũ acio othe a Isiraeli makĩnuguna nĩ ũndũ wa Musa na Harũni, na kĩũngano kĩu gĩothe gĩkĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Naarĩ korwo twakuĩrĩire Misiri! Kana werũ-inĩ ũyũ!
English: All the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron. The whole congregation said to them, “We wish that we had died in the land of Egypt, or that we had died in this wilderness!

Kikuyu: Nĩ kĩĩ gĩgũtũma Jehova atũrehe bũrũri ũyũ atũrekererie tũũragwo na rũhiũ rwa njora? Atumia aitũ na ciana ciitũ megũtuĩka a gũtahwo. Githĩ wega ti tũcooke bũrũri wa Misiri?”
English: Why does Yahweh bring us to this land, to fall by the sword? Our wives and our little ones will be captured or killed! Wouldn’t it be better for us to return into Egypt?”

Kikuyu: Nao makĩĩrana mũndũ na ũrĩa ũngĩ atĩrĩ, “Twagĩrĩirwo nĩ tũthuure mũtongoria tũcooke bũrũri wa Misiri.”
English: They said to one another, “Let’s choose a leader, and let’s return into Egypt.”

Kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo Musa na Harũni makĩĩgũithia maturumithĩtie mothiũ mao thĩ mbere ya kĩũngano kĩu gĩothe kĩa andũ a Isiraeli kĩrĩa kĩagomanĩte hau.
English: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.

Kikuyu: Joshua mũrũ wa Nuni na Kalebu mũrũ wa Jefune, arĩa maarĩ hamwe na arĩa maathiĩte gũthigaana bũrũri ũcio magĩtembũranga nguo ciao.*
English: Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, who were of those who spied out the land, tore their clothes.

Kikuyu: Makĩĩra kĩũngano kĩu gĩothe kĩa andũ a Isiraeli atĩrĩ, “Bũrũri ũrĩa twatuĩkanĩirie na tũkĩũthigana, nĩ bũrũri mwega mũno makĩria.
English: They spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, “The land, which we passed through to spy it out, is an exceedingly good land.

Kikuyu: Jehova angĩkorwo nĩakenetio nĩ ithuĩ, nĩegũtũtongoria tũtoonye bũrũri ũcio, bũrũri ũcio ũiyũrĩte bũthi wa iria na ũũkĩ, na nĩegũtũhe guo ũtuĩke witũ.
English: If Yahweh delights in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it to us: a land which flows with milk and honey.

Kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, mũtikaremere Jehova. Na mũtigetigĩre andũ a bũrũri ũcio, nĩ ũndũ tũkũmameria biũ. Ũgitĩri wao nĩ mweherie, no Jehova arĩ hamwe na ithuĩ. Mũtikametigĩre.”
English: Only don’t rebel against Yahweh, neither fear the people of the land; for they are bread for us. Their defense is removed from over them, and Yahweh is with us. Don’t fear them.”

Kikuyu: No kĩũngano kĩu gĩothe gĩkĩaria ũhoro wa kũmahũũra na mahiga nyuguto. Hĩndĩ ĩyo riiri wa Jehova ũkiumĩrĩra andũ othe a Isiraeli hau Hema-inĩ ya Gũtũnganwo.
English: But all the congregation threatened to stone them with stones. Yahweh’s glory appeared in the Tent of Meeting to all the children of Israel.

Kikuyu: Nake Jehova akĩũria Musa atĩrĩ, “Andũ aya megũtũũra maanyararĩte nginya-rĩ? Megũtũũra maregete kũnjĩtĩkia nginya-rĩ, o na ningĩte ciama nyingĩ ũguo gatagatĩ kao?
English: Yahweh said to Moses, “How long will this people despise me? How long will they not believe in me, for all the signs which I have worked among them?

Kikuyu: Nĩngũmahũũra na mũthiro ndĩmaniine, no wee ngũgũtua rũrĩrĩ rũnene na rũrĩ na hinya kũmakĩra.”
English: I will strike them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of you a nation greater and mightier than they.”

Kikuyu: Musa akĩĩra Jehova atĩrĩ, “Andũ a Misiri nĩmakaigua ũhoro ũcio! Nĩwe warutire andũ aya makiuma gatagatĩ kao na ũndũ wa ũhoti waku.
English: Moses said to Yahweh, “Then the Egyptians will hear it; for you brought up this people in your might from among them.

Kikuyu: Nao nĩmakeera aikari a bũrũri ũyũ ũhoro ũcio. Nĩmaiguĩte atĩ Wee, O Wee Jehova-rĩ, ũkoragwo na andũ aya, na atĩ Wee Jehova, wanonwo ũthiũ kwa ũthiũ, na atĩ itu rĩaku rĩikaraga igũrũ rĩao, o na atĩ Wee ũthiiaga mbere yao thĩinĩ wa gĩtugĩ kĩa itu mũthenya na ũrĩ thĩinĩ wa gĩtugĩ kĩa mwaki ũtukũ.
English: They will tell it to the inhabitants of this land. They have heard that you Yahweh are among this people; for you Yahweh are seen face to face, and your cloud stands over them, and you go before them, in a pillar of cloud by day, and in a pillar of fire by night.

Kikuyu: Ũngĩũraga andũ aya othe o ro rĩmwe-rĩ, ndũrĩrĩ iria ciiguĩte ũhoro ũyũ waku nĩikoiga atĩrĩ,
English: Now if you killed this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of you will speak, saying,

Kikuyu: ‘Jehova nĩaremirwo nĩgũkinyia andũ aya bũrũri ũrĩa aamerĩire na mwĩhĩtwa; nĩ ũndũ ũcio akĩmooragĩra werũ-inĩ.’
English: ‘Because Yahweh was not able to bring this people into the land which he swore to them, therefore he has slain them in the wilderness.’

Kikuyu: “Na rĩrĩ, hinya wa Mwathani ũrokĩonekana o ta ũrĩa ugĩte, atĩrĩ:
English: Now please let the power of the Lord† be great, according as you have spoken, saying,

Kikuyu: ‘Jehova ndahiũhaga kũrakara, aiyũrĩtwo nĩ wendo, na nĩohanagĩra mehia na ũremi. No ndaagaga kũherithia mũndũ ũrĩa wĩhĩtie; nĩaherithagia ciana nĩ ũndũ wa mehia ma maithe nginya rũciaro rwa gatatũ na rwa kana.’
English: ‘Yahweh is slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, forgiving iniquity and disobedience; and he will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, on the third and on the fourth generation.’

Kikuyu: Kũringana na wendo waku mũnene-rĩ, ohera andũ aya mehia mao, o ta ũrĩa wanamarekera kuuma hĩndĩ ĩrĩa moimire bũrũri wa Misiri nginya rĩu.”
English: Please pardon the iniquity of this people according to the greatness of your loving kindness, and just as you have forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.”

Kikuyu: Jehova akĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Nĩ ndamarekera o ta ũguo woria.
English: Yahweh said, “I have pardoned according to your word;

Kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, ti-itherũ o ta ũrĩa niĩ ndũũraga muoyo, na ti-itherũ o ta ũrĩa riiri wa Jehova ũiyũrĩte thĩ yothe-rĩ,
English: but in very deed—as I live, and as all the earth shall be filled with Yahweh’s glory—

Kikuyu: gũtirĩ o na ũmwe wa andũ arĩa moonire riiri wakwa na ciama iria ndaringĩire kũu bũrũri wa Misiri o na gũkũ werũ-inĩ, no makĩĩnemera na makĩĩngeria maita ikũmi-rĩ,
English: because all those men who have seen my glory and my signs, which I worked in Egypt and in the wilderness, yet have tempted me these ten times, and have not listened to my voice;

Kikuyu: gũtirĩ o na ũmwe wa acio ũkoona bũrũri ũcio nderĩire maithe mao ma tene na mwĩhĩtwa. Gũtirĩ o na ũmwe wao wa arĩa maanyararĩte ũkaawona.
English: surely they shall not see the land which I swore to their fathers, neither shall any of those who despised me see it.

Kikuyu: No tondũ ndungata yakwa Kalebu arĩ na roho wa mũthemba ũngĩ na nĩanũmagĩrĩra na ngoro yake yothe, nĩngamũtwara bũrũri ũcio aathiĩte, nacio njiaro ciake nĩikaũgaya.
English: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and has followed me fully, him I will bring into the land into which he went. His offspring shall possess it.

Kikuyu: Na tondũ andũ a Amaleki na a Kaanani matũũraga cianda-inĩ-rĩ, rokai kũgarũrũka mumagare mũrorete na werũ-inĩ, mũthiĩ na njĩra ya Iria Itune.”
English: Since the Amalekite and the Canaanite dwell in the valley, tomorrow turn and go into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.”

Kikuyu: Nake Jehova akĩĩra Musa na Harũni atĩrĩ:
English: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

Kikuyu: “Nĩ nginya hĩndĩ ĩrĩkũ kĩrĩndĩ gĩkĩ kĩaganu gĩgũtũũra kĩĩnugunagĩra? Nĩnjiguĩte mateta ma anugunĩki aya a Isiraeli.
English: “How long shall I bear with this evil congregation that complain against me? I have heard the complaints of the children of Israel, which they complain against me.

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio meere atĩrĩ, ‘Jehova ekuuga ũũ: Ti-itherũ o ta ũrĩa niĩ ndũũraga muoyo-rĩ, nĩ ngũmwĩka o maũndũ macio njiguĩte mũkĩaria.
English: Tell them, ‘As I live, says Yahweh, surely as you have spoken in my ears, so I will do to you.

Kikuyu: Ciimba cianyu ikaagũa werũ-inĩ ũyũ, inyuĩ arĩa othe mũrĩ na ũkũrũ wa mĩaka mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na makĩria arĩa mwatarirwo hĩndĩ ya itarana na arĩa manugunĩte nĩ ũndũ wakwa.
English: Your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness; and all who were counted of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, who have complained against me,

Kikuyu: Gũtirĩ o na ũmwe wanyu ũgatoonya bũrũri ũcio ndehĩtire nyambararĩtie guoko atĩ nĩũgatuĩka wanyu, tiga o Kalebu mũrũ wa Jefune, na Joshua mũrũ wa Nuni.
English: surely you shall not come into the land concerning which I swore that I would make you dwell therein, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

Kikuyu: No ha ũhoro wa ciana cianyu iria mwoigire atĩ nĩ igaatahwo-rĩ, nĩngamakinyia kuo makenagĩre bũrũri ũcio mũregete.
English: But I will bring in your little ones that you said should be captured or killed, and they shall know the land which you have rejected.

Kikuyu: No inyuĩ-rĩ, ciimba cianyu ikaagũa werũ-inĩ ũyũ.
English: But as for you, your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness.

Kikuyu: Ciana cianyu igũtuĩka arĩithi gũkũ werũ-inĩ mĩaka mĩrongo ĩna, igĩthĩnĩkaga nĩ ũndũ wa kwaga kwĩhokeka kwanyu, nginya rĩrĩa kĩimba kĩanyu kĩa mũthia gĩkaagũa werũ-inĩ.
English: Your children shall be wanderers in the wilderness forty years, and shall bear your prostitution, until your dead bodies are consumed in the wilderness.

Kikuyu: Mĩaka mĩrongo ĩna, o mwaka ũmwe ũrũgamĩrĩire mũthenya ũmwe wa mĩthenya mĩrongo ĩna ĩrĩa mwathigaanire bũrũri ũcio, mĩaka ĩyo nĩyo mũgaathĩnĩka nĩ ũndũ wa mehia manyu, na mũmenye ũũru wa gũũkĩrĩrwo nĩ niĩ.’
English: After the number of the days in which you spied out the land, even forty days, for every day a year, you will bear your iniquities, even forty years, and you will know my alienation.’

Kikuyu: Niĩ Jehova nĩ niĩ njarĩtie, na ti-itherũ nĩngeeka maũndũ macio kũrĩ kĩrĩndĩ gĩkĩ gĩothe kĩaganu, kĩrĩa gĩĩcookanĩrĩirie hamwe kĩnjũkĩrĩre. Gĩgaathirĩra werũ-inĩ ũyũ; gũkũ nĩkuo gĩgaakuĩra.”
English: I, Yahweh, have spoken. I will surely do this to all this evil congregation who are gathered together against me. In this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.”

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio, andũ arĩa Musa aatũmĩte magathigaane bũrũri ũcio wa Kaanani, o acio macookire na magĩtũma kĩrĩndĩ gĩothe kĩnugunĩre Musa nĩkũmemerekia ũhoro mũũru wa bũrũri ũcio,
English: The men whom Moses sent to spy out the land, who returned and made all the congregation to murmur against him by bringing up an evil report against the land,

Kikuyu: andũ acio mamemerekirie ũhoro ũcio mũũru wa bũrũri ũcio makĩhũũrwo na mũthiro, magĩkuĩra hau mbere ya Jehova.
English: even those men who brought up an evil report of the land, died by the plague before Yahweh.

Kikuyu: Harĩ andũ arĩa maathiĩte gũthigaana bũrũri ũcio, no Joshua mũrũ wa Nuni, na Kalebu mũrũ wa Jefune maatigarire.
English: But Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh remained alive of those men who went to spy out the land.

Kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Musa aaheire andũ othe a Isiraeli ũhoro ũcio, makĩgirĩka mũno.
English: Moses told these words to all the children of Israel, and the people mourned greatly.

Kikuyu: Mũthenya ũyũ ũngĩ rũciinĩ tene makĩambata marorete bũrũri ũrĩa ũrĩ irĩma. Makiuga atĩrĩ, “Nĩtwĩhĩtie, nĩtũkwambata tũthiĩ nginya kũrĩa Jehova aatwĩrĩire.”
English: They rose up early in the morning and went up to the top of the mountain, saying, “Behold, we are here, and will go up to the place which Yahweh has promised; for we have sinned.”

Kikuyu: No Musa akĩmooria atĩrĩ, “Mũraremera watho wa Jehova nĩkĩ? Ũndũ ũyũ ndũngĩgaacĩra!
English: Moses said, “Why now do you disobey the commandment of Yahweh, since it shall not prosper?

Kikuyu: Mũtikambate tondũ Jehova ndarĩ hamwe na inyuĩ. Nĩmũkũhootwo nĩ thũ cianyu,
English: Don’t go up, for Yahweh isn’t among you; that way you won’t be struck down before your enemies.

Kikuyu: nĩgũkorwo andũ a Amaleki na Akaanani nĩmakarũa na inyuĩ kũu. Nĩ ũndũ nĩ mũhutatĩire Jehova, nake ndegũkorwo hamwe na inyuĩ, na nĩmũkũũragwo na rũhiũ rwa njora.”
English: For there the Amalekite and the Canaanite are before you, and you will fall by the sword because you turned back from following Yahweh; therefore Yahweh will not be with you.”

Kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, nĩ ũndũ wa mwĩĩro wao, makĩambata marorete bũrũri ũrĩa ũrĩ irĩma o na gũkorwo Musa ndoimire kambĩ o na kana ithandũkũ rĩa kĩrĩkanĩro kĩa Jehova rĩkiuma kambĩ.
English: But they presumed to go up to the top of the mountain. Nevertheless, the ark of Yahweh’s covenant and Moses didn’t depart out of the camp.

Kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, andũ a Amaleki na Akaanani arĩa maatũũraga bũrũri ũcio ũrĩ irĩma, magĩikũrũka, makĩmatharĩkĩra, na makĩmahũũra mamaikũrũkĩtie o nginya Horoma.
English: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites who lived in that mountain, and struck them and beat them down even to Hormah.

Kikuyu: Nake Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ,
English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

Kikuyu: “Arĩria andũ a Isiraeli, ũmeere atĩrĩ: ‘Thuutha wa gũtoonya bũrũri ũrĩa ngũmũhe ũtuĩke mũciĩ wanyu,
English: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you have come into the land of your habitations, which I give to you,

Kikuyu: na mũrutĩre Jehova maruta ma njino kuuma rũũru rwa ngʼombe kana rwa mbũri, matuĩke mũtararĩko wa gũkenia Jehova, marĩ maruta ma njino, kana magongona, nĩ ũndũ wa mĩĩhĩtwa ya mwanya, kana maruta ma kwĩyendera kana maruta ma ciathĩ-rĩ,
English: and will make an offering by fire to Yahweh—a burnt offering, or a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or as a free will offering, or in your set feasts, to make a pleasant aroma to Yahweh, of the herd, or of the flock—

Kikuyu: ũrĩa ũrĩĩrehaga iruta rĩake, arĩĩrutagĩra Jehova iruta rĩa mũtu gĩcunjĩ gĩa ikũmi kĩa eba ĩmwe* ya mũtu mũhinyu mũno, ũtukanĩtio na gĩcunjĩ kĩa inya kĩa hini ĩmwe† ya maguta.
English: then he who offers his offering shall offer to Yahweh a meal offering of one tenth of an ephah† of fine flour mixed with one fourth of a hin‡ of oil.

Kikuyu: Harĩ o gatũrũme ka iruta rĩa njino kana igongona, haaragĩria gĩcunjĩ kĩa inya kĩa hini ĩmwe ya ndibei ĩrĩ iruta rĩa kũnyuuo.
English: You shall prepare wine for the drink offering, one fourth of a hin, with the burnt offering or for the sacrifice, for each lamb.

Kikuyu: “ ‘Igongona rĩa ndũrũme-rĩ, haarĩria igongona rĩa mũtu icunjĩ igĩrĩ cia ikũmi cia eba ĩmwe‡ ya mũtu mũhinyu mũno, ũtukanĩtio na gĩcunjĩ gĩa ithatũ kĩa hini ĩmwe§ ya maguta,
English: “ ‘For a ram, you shall prepare for a meal offering two tenths of an ephah§ of fine flour mixed with the third part of a hin of oil;

Kikuyu: na gĩcunjĩ gĩa ithatũ kĩa hini ĩmwe ya ndibei ĩrĩ iruta rĩa kũnyuuo. Rĩrutei rĩrĩ mũtararĩko wa gũkenia Jehova.
English: and for the drink offering you shall offer the third part of a hin of wine, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

Kikuyu: “ ‘Rĩrĩa mũkũhaarĩria gategwa nĩ ũndũ wa iruta rĩa njino kana igongona, nĩ ũndũ wa mwĩhĩtwa wa mwanya kana iruta rĩa ũiguano rĩrutĩirwo Jehova-rĩ,
English: When you prepare a bull for a burnt offering or for a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or for peace offerings to Yahweh,

Kikuyu: rehagai hamwe na ndegwa ĩyo iruta rĩa mũtu icunjĩ ithatũ cia ikũmi cia eba ĩmwe* ya mũtu mũhinyu mũno, ũtukanĩtio na nuthu ya hini ĩmwe† ya maguta.
English: then he shall offer with the bull a meal offering of three tenths of an ephah† of fine flour mixed with half a hin of oil;

Kikuyu: O na ningĩ rehagai nuthu ya hini ĩmwe ya ndibei ĩrĩ iruta rĩa kũnyuuo. Narĩo igongona rĩu rĩgatuĩka iruta rĩa njino rĩrĩ mũtararĩko wa gũkenia Jehova.
English: and you shall offer for the drink offering half a hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

Kikuyu: Ndegwa kana ndũrũme o yothe, kana gatũrũme kana koori o gothe, irĩhaaragĩrio o ro ũguo.
English: Thus it shall be done for each bull, for each ram, for each of the male lambs, or of the young goats.

Kikuyu: Ĩkagai ũguo harĩ o ĩmwe yacio ya iria ciothe mũrĩharagĩria.
English: According to the number that you shall prepare, so you shall do to everyone according to their number.

Kikuyu: “ ‘Mũndũ wothe ũciarĩirwo kwanyu no nginya ekage maũndũ macio ũguo rĩrĩa arĩrehaga iruta rĩa gũcinwo na mwaki rĩrĩ mũtararĩko wa gũkenia Jehova.
English: “ ‘All who are native-born shall do these things in this way, in offering an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ wa njiarwa iria igooka, rĩrĩa rĩothe mũgeni kana mũndũ ũngĩ o wothe ũtũũranĩtie na inyuĩ arĩĩrutaga iruta rĩa gũcinwo na mwaki rĩrĩ mũtararĩko wa gũkenia Jehova-rĩ, no nginya ekage o ta ũrĩa inyuĩ mwĩkaga.
English: If a stranger lives as a foreigner with you, or whoever may be among you throughout your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh, as you do, so he shall do.

Kikuyu: Kĩrĩndĩ gĩkĩ kĩrĩkoragwo na watho o ũmwe wanyu na harĩ mũgeni ũrĩa ũtũũranĩtie na inyuĩ; ũyũ nĩ watho wa gũtũũra nĩ ũndũ wa njiarwa iria igooka. Inyuĩ na mũgeni mũrĩkoragwo mũrĩ o ũndũ ũmwe maitho-inĩ ma Jehova.
English: For the assembly, there shall be one statute for you and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner, a statute forever throughout your generations. As you are, so the foreigner shall be before Yahweh.

Kikuyu: Mawatho mamwe na mwathanĩre ũmwe nĩguo ũrĩhũthagĩrwo harĩ inyuĩ na harĩ mũgeni ũrĩa ũtũũranĩtie na inyuĩ.’ ”
English: One law and one ordinance shall be for you and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner with you.’ ”

Kikuyu: Ningĩ Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ,
English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

Kikuyu: “Arĩria andũ a Isiraeli, ũmeere atĩrĩ: ‘Rĩrĩa mũgatoonya bũrũri ũrĩa ndĩramũtwara,
English: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land where I bring you,

Kikuyu: na mũrĩe irio cia bũrũri ũcio, heanai imwe ciacio irĩ iruta harĩ Jehova.
English: then it shall be that when you eat of the bread of the land, you shall offer up a wave offering to Yahweh.

Kikuyu: Nĩ mũkaaruta tũmĩgate kuuma mũtu-inĩ wanyu ũrĩa mũgaathĩa rĩa mbere na mũtũheane tũrĩ iruta kĩhuhĩro-inĩ kĩa ngano.
English: Of the first of your dough you shall offer up a cake for a wave offering. As the wave offering of the threshing floor, so you shall heave it.

Kikuyu: Nĩmũkaheanaga iruta rĩrĩ rĩa mũtu ũrĩa mũgathĩa rĩa mbere kũrĩ Jehova njiarwa-inĩ cianyu ciothe iria igooka thuutha.
English: Of the first of your dough, you shall give to Yahweh a wave offering throughout your generations.

Kikuyu: “ ‘Na rĩrĩ, mũngĩkaaga kũrũmĩrĩra rĩathani o na rĩmwe rĩa maya Jehova aaheire Musa mũtekwenda-rĩ,
English: “ ‘When you err, and don’t observe all these commandments which Yahweh has spoken to Moses—

Kikuyu: rĩathani o rĩothe Jehova aamũheire na kanua ka Musa kuuma mũthenya ũrĩa Jehova aamaheanire na kũrũmĩrĩra nginya njiarwa iria igooka,
English: even all that Yahweh has commanded you by Moses, from the day that Yahweh gave commandment and onward throughout your generations—

Kikuyu: na ũndũ ũcio ũngĩkorwo wĩkĩtwo mũtekwenda, kĩrĩndĩ gĩtekũmenya ũhoro ũcio, hĩndĩ ĩyo kĩrĩndĩ gĩothe nĩgĩkaruta gategwa gatuĩke igongona rĩa njino rĩna mũtararĩko wa gũkenia Jehova, hamwe na maruta ma mũtu na ma kũnyuuo, marĩa matuĩtwo, na thenge ya igongona rĩa kũhoroheria mehia.
English: then it shall be, if it was done unwittingly, without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bull for a burnt offering, for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh, with its meal offering and its drink offering, according to the ordinance, and one male goat for a sin offering.

Kikuyu: Mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai nĩakahoroheria kĩrĩndĩ kĩu gĩothe kĩa andũ a Isiraeli, na nĩmakarekerwo, nĩgũkorwo ũndũ ũcio ndwarĩ wa rũtũrĩko, na nĩ ũndũ wa kũrutĩra Jehova iruta rĩa gũcinwo na mwaki rĩa mahĩtia mao, na iruta rĩa kũhoroherio mehia.
English: The priest shall make atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and they shall be forgiven; for it was an error, and they have brought their offering, an offering made by fire to Yahweh, and their sin offering before Yahweh, for their error.

Kikuyu: Kĩrĩndĩ gĩothe kĩa andũ a Isiraeli na ageni arĩa matũũranagia nao nĩmakarekerwo, nĩ ũndũ andũ othe mehĩtie matekwenda.
English: All the congregation of the children of Israel shall be forgiven, as well as the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them; for with regard to all the people, it was done unwittingly.

Kikuyu: “ ‘No kũngĩkorwo no mũndũ ũmwe wĩhĩtie atekwenda, no nginya arehe kaharika ka mwaka ũmwe ka igongona rĩa kũhoroherio mehia.
English: “ ‘If a person sins unwittingly, then he shall offer a female goat a year old for a sin offering.

Kikuyu: Mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai nĩakahoroheria mũndũ ũcio wĩhĩtie atekwenda hau mbere ya Jehova na aarĩkia kũhoroherio, nĩakarekerwo.
English: The priest shall make atonement for the soul who errs when he sins unwittingly before Yahweh. He shall make atonement for him; and he shall be forgiven.

Kikuyu: Watho o ro ũmwe nĩguo ũrĩhũthagĩrwo harĩ mũndũ o wothe ũkehia atekwenda, arĩ Mũisiraeli ũciarĩirwo kwanyu kana arĩ mũgeni.
English: You shall have one law for him who does anything unwittingly, for him who is native-born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them.

Kikuyu: “ ‘No mũndũ ũrĩa ũkehia na rũtũrĩko akĩendaga, arĩ wa gũciarĩrwo kwanyu kana arĩ mũgeni, ũcio nĩarumĩte Jehova, na mũndũ ũcio no nginya aingatwo kuuma kũrĩ andũ ao.
English: “ ‘But the soul who does anything with a high hand, whether he is native-born or a foreigner, blasphemes Yahweh. That soul shall be cut off from among his people.

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ nĩ amenete kiugo kĩa Jehova na akoina maathani make, mũndũ ũcio ti-itherũ no nginya aingatwo biũ naguo wĩhia wake nĩũkamũcokerera.’ ”
English: Because he has despised Yahweh’s word, and has broken his commandment, that soul shall be utterly cut off. His iniquity shall be on him.’ ”

Kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa andũ a Isiraeli maarĩ werũ-inĩ, kũrĩ mũndũ wonirwo akiuna ngũ mũthenya wa Thabatũ.
English: While the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering sticks on the Sabbath day.

Kikuyu: Arĩa maamuonire akiuna ngũ makĩmũtwara kũrĩ Musa na Harũni, o na kũrĩ kĩũngano kĩu gĩothe gĩa Isiraeli,
English: Those who found him gathering sticks brought him to Moses and Aaron, and to all the congregation.

Kikuyu: na makĩmũhingĩra nĩ ũndũ gũtiamenyekaga ũrĩa agĩrĩirwo nĩ gwĩkwo.
English: They put him in custody, because it had not been declared what should be done to him.

Kikuyu: Nake Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ, “Mũndũ ũcio no nginya akue. Kĩũngano gĩothe kĩa Isiraeli no nginya kĩmũhũũre na mahiga nyuguto nja ya kambĩ.”
English: Yahweh said to Moses, “The man shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall stone him with stones outside of the camp.”

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio kĩũngano kĩu gĩkĩmũtwara nja ya kambĩ gĩkĩmũhũũra na mahiga nyuguto agĩkua, o ta ũrĩa Jehova aathĩte Musa.
English: All the congregation brought him outside of the camp, and stoned him to death with stones, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

Kikuyu: Nake Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ,
English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

Kikuyu: “Arĩria andũ a Isiraeli, ũmeere atĩrĩ: ‘Njiarwa-inĩ ciothe iria igooka, nĩmũgatumagĩrĩra ciohe cia ndigi koine-inĩ ka nguo cianyu, o kĩohe gĩkohererwo na rũrigi rwa rangi wa bururu.
English: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them that they should make themselves fringes‡ on the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put on the fringe§ of each border a cord of blue.

Kikuyu: Ciohe icio nĩcio mũrĩroraga nĩguo mũririkanage maathani mothe ma Jehova, nĩguo mũmathĩkagĩre, mũtikanahũũre ũmaraya na ũndũ wa kũrũmĩrĩra merirĩria ma ngoro o na kana maitho manyu.
English: It shall be to you for a fringe,† that you may see it, and remember all Yahweh’s commandments, and do them; and that you don’t follow your own heart and your own eyes, after which you used to play the prostitute;

Kikuyu: Ningĩ nĩmũkaririkanaga gwathĩkagĩra maathani makwa mothe na mũtuĩke andũ mamũrĩirwo Ngai wanyu.
English: so that you may remember and do all my commandments, and be holy to your God.

Kikuyu: Niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova Ngai wanyu, ũrĩa wamũrutire bũrũri wa Misiri nĩguo nduĩke Ngai wanyu. Niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova Ngai wanyu.’ ”
English: I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am Yahweh your God.”

Kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, Kora mũrũ wa Iziharu, mũrũ wa Kohathu, ũrĩa warĩ mũrũ wa Lawi, marĩ na andũ amwe a mũhĩrĩga wa Rubeni nĩo Dathani na Abiramu, ariũ a Eliabu, na Oni mũrũ wa Pelethu, magĩtuĩka a kũngʼathia.
English: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, with Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took some men.

Kikuyu: Nao magĩũkĩrĩra Musa. Hamwe nao haarĩ arũme a Isiraeli 250, atongoria mooĩkaine a kĩrĩndĩ kĩu arĩa maathuurĩtwo marĩ a kĩama.
English: They rose up before Moses, with some of the children of Israel, two hundred fifty princes of the congregation, called to the assembly, men of renown.

Kikuyu: Nao magĩũka marĩ gĩkundi makararie Musa na Harũni, makĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Inyuĩ nĩmwĩtũgĩrĩtie mũno! Kĩrĩndĩ gĩkĩ gĩothe nĩ gĩtheru, mũndũ o mũndũ, nake Jehova arĩ hamwe nao. Nĩ kĩĩ gĩtũmĩte mwĩtũũgĩrie igũrũ rĩa kĩũngano gĩkĩ kĩa Jehova?”
English: They assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said to them, “You take too much on yourself, since all the congregation are holy, everyone of them, and Yahweh is among them! Why do you lift yourselves up above Yahweh’s assembly?”

Kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Musa aiguire ũguo-rĩ, akĩgũa, agĩturumithia ũthiũ thĩ.
English: When Moses heard it, he fell on his face.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ agĩcooka akĩĩra Kora na arũmĩrĩri ake othe atĩrĩ: “Rũciinĩ, Jehova nĩakonania nũũ wake na nũũ mũtheru, na nĩakareka mũndũ ũcio amũkuhĩrĩrie. Mũndũ ũrĩa agaathuura, ũcio nĩwe akaareka amũkuhĩrĩrie.
English: He said to Korah and to all his company, “In the morning, Yahweh will show who are his, and who is holy, and will cause him to come near to him. Even him whom he shall choose, he will cause to come near to him.

Kikuyu: Wee Kora na arũmĩrĩri aku othe, ũũ nĩguo mũgeeka: mũkoya ngĩo cia gũcinĩra ũbumba,
English: Do this: have Korah and all his company take censers,

Kikuyu: na rũciũ mũciĩkĩre mwaki na ũbumba mũrĩ mbere ya Jehova. Mũndũ ũrĩa Jehova agaathuura-rĩ, ũcio agaatuĩka nĩwe mũtheru. Inyuĩ Alawii nĩmwĩtũgĩrĩtie mũno!”
English: put fire in them, and put incense on them before Yahweh tomorrow. It shall be that the man whom Yahweh chooses, he shall be holy. You have gone too far, you sons of Levi!”

Kikuyu: Ningĩ Musa akĩĩra Kora atĩrĩ, “Ta thikĩrĩriai inyuĩ Alawii!
English: Moses said to Korah, “Hear now, you sons of Levi!

Kikuyu: Anga mũtiganĩire nĩ Ngai wa Isiraeli kũmwamũrania na kĩrĩndĩ kĩrĩa kĩngĩ gĩothe kĩa andũ a Isiraeli, akamũrehe hakuhĩ nake nĩgeetha mũrutage wĩra hema-inĩ ĩrĩa nyamũre ya Jehova, na mũrũgamage mbere ya kĩrĩndĩ mũgĩtungatagĩre?
English: Is it a small thing to you that the God of Israel has separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself, to do the service of Yahweh’s tabernacle, and to stand before the congregation to minister to them;

Kikuyu: Inyuĩ hamwe na Alawii othe a thiritũ yanyu nĩamũrehete hakuhĩ nake, no rĩu mũrageria kuoya wĩra wa ũthĩnjĩri-Ngai o naguo.
English: and that he has brought you near, and all your brothers the sons of Levi with you? Do you seek the priesthood also?

Kikuyu: Wee na arũmĩrĩri aku othe mũnganĩte hamwe mũũkĩrĩre Jehova. Harũni nũũ atĩ nĩguo mũnugune nĩ ũndũ wake?”
English: Therefore you and all your company have gathered together against Yahweh! What is Aaron that you complain against him?”

Kikuyu: Musa agĩcooka agĩĩta Dathani na Abiramu, ariũ a Eliabu. No-o makiuga atĩrĩ, “Tũtigũũka!
English: Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab; and they said, “We won’t come up!

Kikuyu: Anga ti kũiganu atĩ nĩwatũrutire bũrũri warĩ bũthi wa iria na ũũkĩ ũũke ũtũũragĩre werũ-inĩ ũyũ? Rĩu ningĩ ũrenda gũtwatha?
English: Is it a small thing that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, but you must also make yourself a prince over us?

Kikuyu: Ningĩ-rĩ, ndũrĩ ũratũkinyia bũrũri ũrĩ na bũthi wa iria na ũũkĩ, kana ũgatũhe igai rĩa ithaka na mĩgũnda ya mĩthabibũ. Nĩ ũgũkũũra andũ aya maitho ũmaheenie? Aca, tũtigũũka!”
English: Moreover you haven’t brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey, nor given us inheritance of fields and vineyards. Will you put out the eyes of these men? We won’t come up.”

Kikuyu: Nake Musa akĩrakara mũno, akĩĩra Jehova atĩrĩ, “Ndũgetĩkĩre maruta mao. Niĩ ndioete o na ndigiri kuuma kũrĩ o, o na ndihĩtĩirie mũndũ wao o na ũmwe.”
English: Moses was very angry, and said to Yahweh, “Don’t respect their offering. I have not taken one donkey from them, neither have I hurt one of them.”

Kikuyu: Ningĩ Musa akĩĩra Kora atĩrĩ, “Wee na arũmĩrĩri aku othe mũgooka mbere ya Jehova rũciũ, wee, nao, na Harũni.
English: Moses said to Korah, “You and all your company go before Yahweh, you, and they, and Aaron, tomorrow.

Kikuyu: O mũndũ nĩakoya rũgĩo rwake na arwĩkĩre ũbumba, ngĩo ciothe nĩ 250, na mũcirehe mbere ya Jehova. Wee, na Harũni, o na inyuĩ mũrehe ngĩo cianyu.”
English: Each man take his censer and put incense on it, and each man bring before Yahweh his censer, two hundred fifty censers; you also, and Aaron, each with his censer.”

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio o mũndũ akĩoya rũgĩo rwake, akĩrwĩkĩra mwaki na ũbumba, na makĩrũgamania mbere ya Musa na Harũni itoonyero- inĩ rĩa Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo.
English: They each took his censer, and put fire in it, and laid incense on it, and stood at the door of the Tent of Meeting with Moses and Aaron.

Kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Kora aarĩkirie gũcookereria arũmĩrĩri ake othe nĩguo makararie Musa na Harũni marũngiĩ itoonyero-inĩ rĩa Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo-rĩ, riiri wa Jehova ũkiumĩrĩra kĩũngano kĩu gĩothe.
English: Korah assembled all the congregation opposite them to the door of the Tent of Meeting. Yahweh’s glory appeared to all the congregation.

Kikuyu: Nake Jehova akĩĩra Musa na Harũni atĩrĩ,
English: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

Kikuyu: “Mwĩyamũraniei na kĩũngano gĩkĩ nĩguo ndĩkĩniine o ro rĩmwe.”
English: “Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!”

Kikuyu: No Musa na Harũni makĩĩgũithia magĩturumithia mothiũ mao thĩ makĩanĩrĩra makiuga atĩrĩ, “Wee Ngai, Ngai wa Maroho ma andũ othe, kaĩ ũngĩrakarĩra kĩũngano gĩkĩ gĩothe hĩndĩ ĩrĩa arĩ o mũndũ ũmwe wĩhĩtie?”
English: They fell on their faces, and said, “God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and will you be angry with all the congregation?”

Kikuyu: Nake Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ,
English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

Kikuyu: “Ĩra kĩũngano gĩothe atĩrĩ, ‘Eherai kuuma hema-inĩ cia Kora na Dathani na Abiramu.’ ”
English: “Speak to the congregation, saying, ‘Get away from around the tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram!’ ”

Kikuyu: Musa agĩũkĩra, agĩthiĩ kũrĩ Dathani na Abiramu, nao athuuri a Isiraeli makĩmũrũmĩrĩra.
English: Moses rose up and went to Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.

Kikuyu: Nake agĩkaania kĩũngano kĩu, agĩkĩĩra atĩrĩ, “Ehererai hema cia andũ aya aaganu! Mũtikahutie kĩndũ o na kĩmwe kĩao, nĩguo mũtikaniinwo nĩ ũndũ wa mehia mao mothe.”
English: He spoke to the congregation, saying, “Depart, please, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest you be consumed in all their sins!”

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio andũ makĩeherera hema icio cia Kora na Dathani na Abiramu. Dathani na Abiramu nĩ moimĩte makarũgama na atumia ao, na ciana cia ngenge itoonyero-inĩ rĩa hema ciao.
English: So they went away from the tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side. Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood at the door of their tents with their wives, their sons, and their little ones.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ Musa akiuga atĩrĩ, “Ũndũ ũyũ nĩguo ũgũtũma mũmenye atĩ Jehova nĩwe ũndũmĩte njĩke maũndũ maya mothe, na atĩ rĩtiarĩ ithugunda rĩakwa:
English: Moses said, “Hereby you shall know that Yahweh has sent me to do all these works; for they are not from my own mind.

Kikuyu: Andũ aya mangĩkua gĩkuũ kĩa ndũire-rĩ, o na kana mone maũndũ o ta marĩa makoraga andũ othe-rĩ, nĩmũkũmenya atĩ ti Jehova ũndũmĩte.
English: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they experience what all men experience, then Yahweh hasn’t sent me.

Kikuyu: No Jehova angĩrehe ũndũ ũngĩ mwerũ biũ, nayo thĩ yathamie kanua kayo ĩmamerie hamwe na indo ciao ciothe, na mathiĩ mbĩrĩra-inĩ marĩ muoyo, nĩmũkamenya atĩ andũ aya nĩ manyararĩte Jehova.”
English: But if Yahweh makes a new thing, and the ground opens its mouth, and swallows them up with all that belong to them, and they go down alive into Sheol,† then you shall understand that these men have despised Yahweh.”

Kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, Musa aarĩkia kuuga ũguo wothe, thĩ ĩgĩatũka hau maarĩ.
English: As he finished speaking all these words, the ground that was under them split apart.

Kikuyu: Nayo thĩ ĩgĩathamia kanua kayo ĩkĩmameria, hamwe na andũ ao na arũmĩrĩri othe a Kora, na indo ciao ciothe.
English: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up with their households, all of Korah’s men, and all their goods.

Kikuyu: Nao magĩikũrũka mbĩrĩra marĩ muoyo hamwe na indo ciao ciothe; nayo thĩ ĩkĩmahumbĩra, magĩkua, magĩthengio kĩrĩndĩ-inĩ kĩu.
English: So they, and all that belonged to them went down alive into Sheol.‡ The earth closed on them, and they perished from among the assembly.

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ wa kĩrĩro kĩao, andũ othe a Isiraeli arĩa maamarigiicĩirie makĩũra, makĩanagĩrĩra atĩrĩ, “O na ithuĩ thĩ nĩĩgũtũmeria!”
English: All Israel that were around them fled at their cry; for they said, “Lest the earth swallow us up!”

Kikuyu: Naguo mwaki ũkiuma kũrĩ Jehova ũgĩcina andũ acio 250 arĩa maarehete ũbumba.
English: Fire came out from Yahweh, and devoured the two hundred fifty men who offered the incense.

Kikuyu: Nake Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ,
English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

Kikuyu: “Ĩra Eleazaru mũrũ wa Harũni, ũrĩa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai, oe ngĩo icio cia gũcinĩrwo ũbumba, acieherie hau irahĩĩra, na ahurunje makara macio handũ haraaya, nĩ ũndũ ngĩo icio nĩ nyamũre,
English: “Speak to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter the fire away from the camp; for they are holy,

Kikuyu: ngĩo icio cia andũ acio makuĩte nĩ ũndũ wa mehia mao. Ngĩo icio nĩiturwo ituĩke mabati ma kũhumbĩra kĩgongona, nĩ ũndũ nĩciarehetwo mbere ya Jehova, na igatuĩka nyamũre. Nacio nĩ ituĩke kĩmenyithia harĩ andũ a Isiraeli.”
English: even the censers of those who sinned against their own lives. Let them be beaten into plates for a covering of the altar, for they offered them before Yahweh. Therefore they are holy. They shall be a sign to the children of Israel.”

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Eleazaru ũrĩa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai akĩoya ngĩo icio cia gĩcango ciarehetwo nĩ andũ acio maacinĩtwo, nake agĩciturithia ituĩke cia kũhumbĩra kĩgongona,
English: Eleazar the priest took the bronze censers which those who were burned had offered; and they beat them out for a covering of the altar,

Kikuyu: agĩĩka o ta ũrĩa Jehova aathĩrĩire Musa. Ũndũ ũyũ warĩ wa kũririkania andũ a Isiraeli atĩ gũtirĩ mũndũ o na ũrĩkũ, tiga wa rũciaro rwa Harũni, wagĩrĩirwo nĩ gũũka gũcina ũbumba mbere ya Jehova, kana atuĩke ta Kora na arũmĩrĩri ake.
English: to be a memorial to the children of Israel, to the end that no stranger who isn’t of the offspring of Aaron, would come near to burn incense before Yahweh, that he not be as Korah and as his company; as Yahweh spoke to him by Moses.

Kikuyu: Mũthenya ũyũ ũngĩ, kĩrĩndĩ gĩothe kĩa andũ a Isiraeli gĩgĩtetia Musa na Harũni, gĩkĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Inyuĩ nĩ mũũragĩte andũ a Jehova.”
English: But on the next day all the congregation of the children of Israel complained against Moses and against Aaron, saying, “You have killed Yahweh’s people!”

Kikuyu: Na rĩrĩa kĩũngano kĩu gĩecookanĩrĩirie gĩũkĩrĩre Musa na Harũni, o na gĩkĩerekera na kũrĩa Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo yarĩ-rĩ, o rĩmwe itu rĩkĩhumbĩra hema ĩyo, naguo riiri wa Jehova ũkĩonekana.
