Kikuyu: Nacio njiaro cia Juda kũringana na mbarĩ ciao nĩ ici: kuuma kũrĩ Shela, nĩ mbarĩ ya Ashela; kuuma kũrĩ Perezu, nĩ mbarĩ ya Aperezu; kuuma kũrĩ Zera, nĩ mbarĩ ya Azera.
English: The sons of Judah after their families were: of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites; of Perez, the family of the Perezites; of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites.

Kikuyu: Nacio njiaro cia Perezu ciarĩ ici: kuuma kũrĩ Hezironi, nĩ mbarĩ ya Ahezironi; kuuma kũrĩ Hamuli, nĩ mbarĩ ya Ahamuli.
English: The sons of Perez were: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.

Kikuyu: Icio nĩcio ciarĩ mbarĩ cia Juda; arĩa maatarirwo maarĩ andũ 76,500.
English: These are the families of Judah according to those who were counted of them, seventy-six thousand five hundred.

Kikuyu: Nacio njiaro cia Isakaru kũringana na mbarĩ ciao ciarĩ ici: kuuma kũrĩ Tola, nĩ mbarĩ ya Atola; kuuma kũrĩ Puva nĩ mbarĩ ya Apuva;
English: The sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites; of Puvah, the family of the Punites;

Kikuyu: kuuma kũrĩ Jashubu, nĩ mbarĩ ya Ajashubu; kuuma kũrĩ Shimuroni, nĩ mbarĩ ya Ashimuroni.
English: of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites; of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.

Kikuyu: Icio nĩcio ciarĩ mbarĩ cia Isakaru; arĩa maatarirwo maarĩ andũ 64,300.
English: These are the families of Issachar according to those who were counted of them, sixty-four thousand three hundred.

Kikuyu: Nacio njiaro cia Zebuluni kũringana na mbarĩ ciao ciarĩ ici: kuuma kũrĩ Seredi, nĩ mbarĩ ya Aseredi; kuuma kũrĩ Eloni nĩ mbarĩ ya Aeloni, na kuuma kũrĩ Jahaleeli, nĩ mbarĩ ya Ajahaleeli.
English: The sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Seredites; of Elon, the family of the Elonites; of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.

Kikuyu: Icio nĩcio ciarĩ mbarĩ cia Zebuluni; arĩa maatarirwo maarĩ andũ 60,500.
English: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those who were counted of them, sixty thousand five hundred.

Kikuyu: Nacio njiaro cia Jusufu kũringana na mbarĩ ciao kuuma kũrĩ Manase na Efiraimu ciarĩ ici:
English: The sons of Joseph after their families: Manasseh and Ephraim.

Kikuyu: Njiaro cia Manase: kuuma kũrĩ Makiru, nĩ mbarĩ ya Amakiru (Makiru nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Gileadi); kuuma kũrĩ Gileadi nĩ mbarĩ ya Agileadi.
English: The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites; and Machir became the father of Gilead; of Gilead, the family of the Gileadites.

Kikuyu: Ici nĩcio njiaro cia Gileadi: kuuma kũrĩ Iezeri, nĩ mbarĩ ya Aiezeli; kuuma kũrĩ Heleku, nĩ mbarĩ ya Aheleku;
English: These are the sons of Gilead: of Iezer, the family of the Iezerites; of Helek, the family of the Helekites;

Kikuyu: kuuma kũrĩ Asirieli, nĩ mbarĩ ya Aasirieli; kuuma kũrĩ Shekemu, nĩ mbarĩ ya Ashekemu;
English: and Asriel, the family of the Asrielites; and Shechem, the family of the Shechemites;

Kikuyu: kuuma kũrĩ Shemida, nĩ mbarĩ ya Ashemida; kuuma kũrĩ Heferi, nĩ mbarĩ ya Aheferi.
English: and Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites; and Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.

Kikuyu: (Zelofehadi mũrũ wa Heferi ndaarĩ na aanake, no airĩtu atheri, namo marĩĩtwa mao maarĩ Mahala, na Noa, na Hogila, na Milika, na Tiriza.)
English: Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

Kikuyu: Icio nĩcio ciarĩ mbarĩ cia Manase, arĩa maatarirwo maarĩ andũ 52,700.
English: These are the families of Manasseh. Those who were counted of them were fifty-two thousand seven hundred.

Kikuyu: Ici nĩcio njiaro cia Efiraimu kũringana na mbarĩ ciao: kuuma kũrĩ Shuthela, nĩ mbarĩ ya Ashuthela; kuuma kũrĩ Bekeri, nĩ mbarĩ ya Abekeri; kuuma kũrĩ Tahani nĩ mbarĩ ya Atahani.
English: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthelahites; of Becher, the family of the Becherites; of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.

Kikuyu: Ici nĩcio ciarĩ njiaro cia Shuthela; kuuma kũrĩ Erani, nĩ mbarĩ ya Aerani.
English: These are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.

Kikuyu: Ici nĩcio ciarĩ mbarĩ cia Efiraimu; arĩa maatarirwo maarĩ andũ 32,500. Icio nĩcio njiaro cia Jusufu kũringana na mbarĩ ciao.
English: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those who were counted of them, thirty-two thousand five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.

Kikuyu: Nacio njiaro cia Benjamini kũringana na mbarĩ ciao ciarĩ ici: kuuma kũrĩ Bela, nĩ mbarĩ ya Abela; kuuma kũrĩ Ashibeli, nĩ mbarĩ ya Aashibeli; kuuma kũrĩ Ahiramu, nĩ mbarĩ ya Aahiramu;
English: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites; of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites; of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites;

Kikuyu: kuuma kũrĩ Shefufamu, nĩ mbarĩ ya Ashefufamu; kuuma kũrĩ Hufamu, nĩ mbarĩ ya Ahufamu.
English: of Shephupham, the family of the Shuphamites; of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.

Kikuyu: Nacio njiaro cia Bela kuuma kũrĩ Aridi na Naamani ciarĩ ici: kuuma kũrĩ Aridi, nĩ mbarĩ ya Aaridi; na kuuma kũrĩ Naamani nĩ mbarĩ ya Anaamani.
English: The sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: the family of the Ardites; and of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.

Kikuyu: Ici nĩcio ciarĩ mbarĩ cia Benjamini; arĩa maatarirwo maarĩ andũ 45,600.
English: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families; and those who were counted of them were forty-five thousand six hundred.

Kikuyu: Nacio njiaro cia Dani kũringana na mbarĩ ciao ciarĩ ici: kuuma kũrĩ Shuhamu nĩ mbarĩ ya Ashuhamu. Icio nĩcio ciarĩ mbarĩ ya Dani.
English: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.

Kikuyu: Acio othe maarĩ a mbarĩ cia Ashuhamu: na arĩa maatarirwo maarĩ andũ 64,400.
English: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those who were counted of them, were sixty-four thousand four hundred.

Kikuyu: Nacio njiaro cia Asheri kũringana na mbarĩ ciao ciarĩ ici: kuuma kũrĩ Imuna, nĩ mbarĩ ya Aimuna; kuuma kũrĩ Ishivi, nĩ mbarĩ ya Aishivi; kuuma kũrĩ Beria, nĩ mbarĩ ya Aberia;
English: The sons of Asher after their families: of Imnah, the family of the Imnites; of Ishvi, the family of the Ishvites; of Beriah, the family of the Berites.

Kikuyu: nao aya nĩo maarĩ a njiaro cia Beria: kuuma kũrĩ Heberi, nĩ mbarĩ ya Aheberi; na kuuma kũrĩ Malikieli, nĩ mbarĩ ya Amalikieli.
English: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.

Kikuyu: (Asheri aarĩ na mwarĩ wetagwo Sera.)
English: The name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.

Kikuyu: Icio nĩcio ciarĩ mbarĩ cia Asheri; arĩa maatarirwo maarĩ andũ 53,400.
English: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those who were counted of them, fifty-three thousand four hundred.

Kikuyu: Nacio njiaro cia Nafitali kũringana na mbarĩ ciao ciarĩ ici: kuuma kũrĩ Jahazeeli, nĩ mbarĩ ya Ajahazeeli; kuuma kũrĩ Guni, nĩ mbarĩ ya Aguni;
English: The sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites; of Guni, the family of the Gunites;

Kikuyu: kuuma kũrĩ Jezeri, nĩ mbarĩ ya Ajezeri; kuuma kũrĩ Shilemu, nĩ mbarĩ ya Ashilemu.
English: of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites; of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.

Kikuyu: Ici nĩcio ciarĩ mbarĩ cia Nafitali; arĩa maatarirwo maarĩ andũ 45,400.
English: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families; and those who were counted of them were forty-five thousand four hundred.

Kikuyu: Mũigana wa arũme acio othe a Isiraeli maarĩ andũ 601,730.
English: These are those who were counted of the children of Israel, six hundred one thousand seven hundred thirty.

Kikuyu: Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ,
English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

Kikuyu: “Bũrũri ũyũ nĩguo makagaĩrwo ũtuĩke igai rĩao kũringana na mũigana wa marĩĩtwa mao.
English: “To these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.

Kikuyu: Andũ arĩa aingĩ ũmagaĩre igai inene, nao arĩa maanyiiha ũmagaĩre igai inini; o mũhĩrĩga ũheo igai rĩaguo kũringana na mũigana wa andũ arĩa maandĩkĩtwo.
English: To the more you shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer you shall give the less inheritance. To everyone according to those who were counted of him shall his inheritance be given.

Kikuyu: Na ũmenyerere wega atĩ, bũrũri ũyũ ũkaaheanwo na ũndũ wa gũcuuka mĩtĩ. Kĩrĩa o gĩkundi gĩkaagaya gĩkaringana na marĩĩtwa ma mĩhĩrĩga ya maithe mao ma tene.
English: Notwithstanding, the land shall be divided by lot. According to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.

Kikuyu: O igai rĩkaheanwo na ũndũ wa gũcuuka mĩtĩ kũrĩ ikundi iria nene na iria nini.”
English: According to the lot shall their inheritance be divided between the more and the fewer.”

Kikuyu: Aya nĩo Alawii arĩa maatarirwo kũringana na mbarĩ ciao: kuuma kũrĩ Gerishoni, nĩ mbarĩ ya Agerishoni; kuuma kũrĩ Kohathu, nĩ mbarĩ ya Akohathu; kuuma kũrĩ Merari, nĩ mbarĩ ya Amerari.
English: These are those who were counted of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites.

Kikuyu: O nacio ici ciarĩ mbarĩ cia Alawii: mbarĩ ya Alibini, na mbarĩ ya Ahebironi, na mbarĩ ya Amahali, na mbarĩ ya Amushi, na mbarĩ ya Akora. (Kohathu aarĩ guka wa Amuramu;
English: These are the families of Levi: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, and the family of the Korahites. Kohath became the father of Amram.

Kikuyu: nake mũtumia wa Amuramu eetagwo Jokebedi, wa rũciaro rwa Lawi, waciarĩirwo Alawii kũu bũrũri wa Misiri. Nake Jokebedi agĩciarĩra Amuramu Harũni, na Musa, na mwarĩ wa nyina wao Miriamu.
English: The name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt. She bore to Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.

Kikuyu: Harũni nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Nadabu na Abihu na Eleazaru na Ithamaru.
English: To Aaron were born Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

Kikuyu: No Nadabu na Abihu nĩmakuire rĩrĩa maarutĩire Jehova igongona na mwaki ũtaarĩ mwĩtĩkĩrie.)
English: Nadab and Abihu died when they offered strange fire before Yahweh.

Kikuyu: Alawii othe arũme a ũkũrũ wa mweri ũmwe na makĩria arĩa maatarirwo maarĩ andũ 23,000. Matiataranĩirio hamwe na andũ a Isiraeli arĩa angĩ tondũ matiagaire kĩndũ hamwe na andũ arĩa angĩ.
English: Those who were counted of them were twenty-three thousand, every male from a month old and upward; for they were not counted among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.

Kikuyu: Acio nĩo maatarirwo nĩ Musa na Eleazaru ũrĩa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai rĩrĩa maatarĩire andũ a Isiraeli werũ-inĩ wa Moabi hũgũrũrũ-inĩ cia Rũũĩ rwa Jorodani, mũrĩmo ũyũ wa Jeriko.
English: These are those who were counted by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who counted the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

Kikuyu: Hatiarĩ o na ũmwe wa arĩa matarĩtwo nĩ Musa na Harũni ũrĩa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai, hĩndĩ ĩrĩa maatarĩire andũ a Isiraeli werũ- inĩ wa Sinai.
English: But among these there was not a man of them who were counted by Moses and Aaron the priest, who counted the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ Jehova nĩeerĩte andũ a Isiraeli atĩ ti-itherũ no nginya makuĩre werũ-inĩ, na gũtirĩ o na ũmwe wao watigarire, tiga no Kalebu mũrũ wa Jefune, na Joshua mũrũ wa Nuni.
English: For Yahweh had said of them, “They shall surely die in the wilderness.” There was not a man left of them, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

Kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, airĩtu acio a Zelofehadi mũrũ wa Heferi mũrũ wa Gileadi, mũrũ wa Makiru, mũrũ wa Manase maarĩ a mbarĩ cia Manase mũrũ wa Jusufu. Marĩĩtwa ma airĩtu acio maarĩ Mahala, na Noa, na Hogila, na Milika, na Tiriza. Nĩmathiire, magĩkuhĩrĩria
English: Then the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph came near. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

Kikuyu: itoonyero rĩa Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo, makĩrũgama mbere ya Musa, na Eleazaru ũrĩa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai, na mbere ya atongoria, o na kĩũngano gĩothe gĩa Isiraeli, makiuga atĩrĩ,
English: They stood before Moses, before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, at the door of the Tent of Meeting, saying,

Kikuyu: “Ithe witũ aakuĩrĩire werũ-inĩ. Ndaarĩ ũmwe wa arũmĩrĩri a Kora, arĩa manyiitanire mokĩrĩre Jehova, no aakuire nĩ ũndũ wa mehia make mwene na ndaarĩ na aanake.
English: “Our father died in the wilderness. He was not among the company of those who gathered themselves together against Yahweh in the company of Korah, but he died in his own sin. He had no sons.

Kikuyu: Nĩ kĩĩ gĩgũtũma rĩĩtwa rĩa awa rĩniinwo mbarĩ-inĩ yao, nĩ ũndũ atĩ ndaarĩ na mwanake? Tũhei igai hamwe na andũ a nyũmba ya ithe witũ.”
English: Why should the name of our father be taken away from among his family, because he had no son? Give to us a possession among the brothers of our father.”

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Musa agĩtwarĩra Jehova ũhoro ũcio wao,
English: Moses brought their cause before Yahweh.

Kikuyu: nake Jehova akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ,
English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

Kikuyu: “Ũguo airĩtu a Zelofehadi maroiga nĩ kĩhooto. Ti-itherũ nĩ wega ũmaheanĩrie igai rĩao na andũ a nyũmba ya ithe wao, o narĩo igai rĩa ithe wao ũmahe.
English: “The daughters of Zelophehad speak right. You shall surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father’s brothers. You shall cause the inheritance of their father to pass to them.

Kikuyu: “Ĩra andũ a Isiraeli atĩrĩ, ‘Mũndũ angĩkua na ndatige mwana wa kahĩĩ, mwarĩ nĩaheo igai rĩake.
English: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If a man dies, and has no son, then you shall cause his inheritance to pass to his daughter.

Kikuyu: Angĩgakorwo atarĩ na mũirĩtu-rĩ, heagai ariũ a nyina igai rĩake.
English: If he has no daughter, then you shall give his inheritance to his brothers.

Kikuyu: Angĩgakorwo atarĩ na ariũ a nyina- rĩ, heagai ariũ a nyina na ithe igai rĩake.
English: If he has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.

Kikuyu: Angĩkorwo ithe ndaarĩ na ariũ a nyina-rĩ, heagai mũndũ wa mbarĩ yao ũrĩa marĩ a igai rĩake, nĩguo rĩtuĩke rĩake. Ũndũ ũcio ũgũtuĩka watho wa kũrũmagĩrĩrwo nĩ andũ a Isiraeli, o ta ũrĩa Jehova aathire Musa.’ ”
English: If his father has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his kinsman who is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it. This shall be a statute and ordinance for the children of Israel, as Yahweh commanded Moses.’ ”

Kikuyu: Ningĩ Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ, “Ũkĩra wambate kĩrĩma-inĩ gĩkĩ, kũu rũgongo rwa Abarimu, wĩrorere bũrũri ũrĩa heete andũ a Isiraeli.
English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, and see the land which I have given to the children of Israel.

Kikuyu: Warĩkia kũwona, we nĩũgũkua o ta ũrĩa Harũni mũrũ wa nyũkwa aakuire, na ũcookanĩrĩrio na andũ anyu,
English: When you have seen it, you also shall be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother was gathered;

Kikuyu: nĩgũkorwo rĩrĩa kĩrĩndĩ kĩanemeire hau maaĩ- inĩ ma Werũ wa Zini, wee na Harũni inyuĩ eerĩ mũtiathĩkĩire watho wakwa, nĩmwagire kũndĩĩithia nĩguo muonanie atĩ ndĩ mũtheru mbere ya maitho mao.” (Maaĩ macio nĩ marĩa ma Meriba Kadeshi, Werũ-inĩ wa Zini.)
English: because in the strife of the congregation, you rebelled against my word in the wilderness of Zin, to honor me as holy at the waters before their eyes.” (These are the waters of Meribah of Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.)

Kikuyu: Musa akĩĩra Jehova atĩrĩ,
English: Moses spoke to Yahweh, saying,

Kikuyu: “Jehova-Ngai wa maroho ma andũ othe, nĩagĩthuure mũndũ atuĩke mũrori wa kĩrĩndĩ gĩkĩ,
English: “Let Yahweh, the God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation,

Kikuyu: atwaranage nakĩo gĩkiumagara na gĩkĩinũka, ũrĩa ũrĩgĩtongoragia gĩgĩthiĩ na gĩgĩcooka, nĩguo kĩrĩndĩ gĩkĩ kĩa Jehova gĩtigatuĩke ta ngʼondu itarĩ na mũrĩithi.”
English: who may go out before them, and who may come in before them, and who may lead them out, and who may bring them in, that the congregation of Yahweh may not be as sheep which have no shepherd.”

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ, “Oya Joshua mũrũ wa Nuni, mũndũ ũrĩ na roho thĩinĩ wake, na ũmũigĩrĩre guoko gwaku.
English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Take Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the Spirit, and lay your hand on him.

Kikuyu: Mũrũgamie mbere ya Eleazaru ũrĩa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai, na mbere ya kĩũngano gĩothe ũmũtue mũtongoria wao hau mbere yao.
English: Set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and commission him in their sight.

Kikuyu: Ũmũhe ũhoti ũmwe waku, nĩgeetha kĩrĩndĩ gĩothe kĩa andũ a Isiraeli kĩmwathĩkagĩre.
English: You shall give authority to him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may obey.

Kikuyu: Nake arũgamage mbere ya Eleazaru ũcio mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai, ũrĩa ũrĩmũtuĩragĩria ũhoro na ũndũ wa kũũria Urimu mbere ya Jehova. Rĩrĩa aathana, hamwe na kĩrĩndĩ gĩothe kĩa andũ a Isiraeli makoimagara, ningĩ aathana rĩngĩ makainũka.”
English: He shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire for him by the judgment of the Urim before Yahweh. At his word they shall go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.”

Kikuyu: Musa agĩĩka o ta ũguo Jehova aamwathĩte. Akĩoya Joshua, na akĩmũrũgamia mbere ya Eleazaru ũrĩa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai o na mbere ya kĩũngano kĩu gĩothe.
English: Moses did as Yahweh commanded him. He took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest and before all the congregation.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ akĩmũigĩrĩra moko make na akĩmũtua mũtongoria wao o ta ũrĩa Jehova aathĩte Musa.
English: He laid his hands on him and commissioned him, as Yahweh spoke by Moses.

Kikuyu: Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ,
English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

Kikuyu: “He andũ a Isiraeli watho ũyũ, ũmeere atĩrĩ: ‘Menyagĩrĩrai muone atĩ nĩ mwandehere irio cia maruta makwa ma gũcinwo na mwaki ihinda rĩrĩa rĩagĩrĩire, irĩ mũtararĩko mwega wa kũngenia.’
English: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘See that you present my offering, my food for my offerings made by fire, as a pleasant aroma to me, in their due season.’

Kikuyu: Meere atĩrĩ, ‘Rĩĩrĩ nĩrĩo iruta rĩa gũcinwo na mwaki rĩrĩa mũrĩrehagĩra Jehova: nĩ tũtũrũme twĩrĩ, o kamwe ka ũkũrũ wa mwaka ũmwe, tũtarĩ na kaũũgũ, rĩtuĩke igongona rĩa kũrutagwo rĩa njino hĩndĩ ciothe o mũthenya.
English: You shall tell them, ‘This is the offering made by fire which you shall offer to Yahweh: male lambs a year old without defect, two day by day, for a continual burnt offering.

Kikuyu: Haaragĩriai gatũrũme kamwe rũciinĩ, na karĩa kangĩ hwaĩ-inĩ kũrĩ mairia,
English: You shall offer the one lamb in the morning, and you shall offer the other lamb at evening,

Kikuyu: hamwe na iruta rĩa mũtu gĩcunjĩ gĩa ikũmi kĩa eba ĩmwe* ya mũtu mũhinyu mũno, ũtukanĩtio na gĩcunjĩ gĩa kana kĩa hini ĩmwe† ya maguta mahihĩtwo kuuma kũrĩ ndamaiyũ.
English: with one tenth of an ephah† of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with the fourth part of a hin‡ of beaten oil.

Kikuyu: Rĩu nĩrĩo igongona rĩa njino rĩa hĩndĩ ciothe rĩrĩa rĩaathanirwo Kĩrĩma-inĩ gĩa Sinai, rĩrĩ mũtararĩko mwega, igongona rĩrutĩirwo Jehova rĩa gũcinwo na mwaki.
English: It is a continual burnt offering which was ordained in Mount Sinai for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

Kikuyu: Nakĩo kĩndũ gĩa kũnyuuo kĩrĩa kĩrĩrutanagĩrio na igongona rĩu kĩrĩkoragwo kĩrĩ gĩcunjĩ gĩa kana kĩa hini ĩmwe‡ ya ndibei ngagatu harĩ o gatũrũme kamwe. Itagĩrai Jehova iruta rĩu rĩa kũnyuuo handũ-harĩa-haamũre.
English: Its drink offering shall be the fourth part of a hin§ for each lamb. You shall pour out a drink offering of strong drink to Yahweh in the holy place.

Kikuyu: Haragĩriai gatũrũme ga keerĩ hwaĩ-inĩ kũrĩ mairia hamwe na iruta rĩa mũtu o na iruta rĩa kĩndũ gĩa kũnyuuo o ta ũrĩa mũharagĩria rĩa rũciinĩ. Rĩu nĩrĩo igongona rĩa gũcinwo na mwaki rĩrĩ na mũtararĩko mwega wa gũkenia Jehova.
English: The other lamb you shall offer at evening. As the meal offering of the morning, and as its drink offering, you shall offer it, an offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

Kikuyu: “ ‘Mũthenya wa thabatũ-rĩ, rutagai iruta rĩa tũtũrũme twĩrĩ, o kamwe ka ũkũrũ wa mwaka ũmwe, tũtarĩ na kaũũgũ, hamwe na kĩndũ kĩa iruta rĩa kũnyuuo, na iruta rĩa mũtu icunjĩ igĩrĩ cia ikũmi cia eba ĩmwe§ ya mũtu mũhinyu mũno ũtukanĩtio na maguta.
English: “ ‘On the Sabbath day, you shall offer two male lambs a year old without defect, and two tenths of an ephah† of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, and its drink offering:

Kikuyu: Rĩĩrĩ nĩrĩo igongona rĩa njino rĩa kũrutagwo o mũthenya wothe wa Thabatũ, hamwe na igongona rĩa njino rĩa hĩndĩ ciothe, na iruta rĩa kĩndũ kĩarĩo gĩa kũnyuuo.
English: this is the burnt offering of every Sabbath, in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

Kikuyu: “ ‘Kĩambĩrĩria kĩa o mweri-rĩ, rutagĩrai Jehova igongona rĩa njino rĩa tũtegwa twĩrĩ na ndũrũme ĩmwe na tũtũrũme mũgwanja o kamwe ka ũkũrũ wa mwaka ũmwe, tuothe tũtarĩ na kaũũgũ.
English: “ ‘In the beginnings of your months, you shall offer a burnt offering to Yahweh: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect,

Kikuyu: Harĩ o ndegwa hagĩage na iruta rĩa mũtu icunjĩ ithatũ cia ikũmi cia eba ĩmwe* ya mũtu mũhinyu mũno, ũtukanĩtio na maguta; na harĩ ndũrũme hagĩe iruta rĩa mũtu icunjĩ igĩrĩ cia ikũmi cia eba ĩmwe† ya mũtu mũhinyu mũno ũtukanĩtio na maguta;
English: and three tenths of an ephah‡ of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, for each bull; and two tenth parts of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, for the one ram;

Kikuyu: na harĩ o gatũrũme hagĩage na iruta rĩa mũtu gĩcunjĩ gĩa ikũmi kĩa eba ĩmwe‡ ya mũtu mũhinyu mũno ũtukanĩtio na maguta. Rĩrĩ nĩ igongona rĩa njino, rĩrĩ na mũtararĩko mwega, rĩrutĩirwo Jehova na ũndũ wa gũcinwo na mwaki.
English: and one tenth part of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering to every lamb, as a burnt offering of a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

Kikuyu: Harĩ o ndegwa nĩ harĩkoragwo na iruta rĩa kũnyuuo rĩa nuthu ya hini ĩmwe§ ya ndibei; na harĩ ndũrũme, nĩ gĩcunjĩ gĩa ithatũ kĩa hini ĩmwe;* na harĩ o gatũrũme, nĩ gĩcunjĩ kĩa inya kĩa hini ĩmwe.† Rĩu nĩrĩo igongona rĩa njino rĩa o mweri rĩrĩa rĩrĩrutagwo o karũgamo ka mweri, mwaka wothe.
English: Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bull, the third part of a hin for the ram, and the fourth part of a hin for a lamb. This is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.

Kikuyu: Hamwe na igongona rĩa njino rĩu rĩa hĩndĩ ciothe na kĩndũ kĩarĩo gĩa kũnyuuo, Jehova nĩarĩrutagĩrwo thenge ĩmwe ĩrĩ ya igongona rĩa kũhoroheria mehia.
English: Also, one male goat for a sin offering to Yahweh shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

Kikuyu: “ ‘Mũthenya wa ikũmi na ĩna wa mweri wa mbere nĩrĩo mũrĩkoragwo na Bathaka ya Jehova.
English: “ ‘In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is Yahweh’s Passover.

Kikuyu: Mũthenya wa ikũmi na ĩtano wa mweri ũcio nĩguo mũrĩgĩaga na gĩathĩ; mĩthenya mũgwanja mũrĩĩage mĩgate ĩtarĩ mĩĩkĩre ndawa ya kũimbia.
English: On the fifteenth day of this month shall be a feast. Unleavened bread shall be eaten for seven days.

Kikuyu: Mũthenya wa mbere mũgĩage na kĩũngano kĩamũre na mũtikarutage wĩra wa ndũire.
English: In the first day shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work,

Kikuyu: Rehagĩrai Jehova iruta rĩa gũcinwo na mwaki, igongona rĩa njino rĩa tũtegwa twĩrĩ, na ndũrũme ĩmwe na tũtũrũme mũgwanja o kamwe ka ũkũrũ wa mwaka ũmwe, ciothe itarĩ na kaũũgũ.
English: but you shall offer an offering made by fire, a burnt offering to Yahweh: two young bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old. They shall be without defect,

Kikuyu: Harĩ o ndegwa ĩmwe haaragĩriai iruta rĩa mũtu gĩcunjĩ gĩa ithatũ gĩa ikũmi kĩa eba ĩmwe‡ ya mũtu mũhinyu mũno ũtukanĩtio na maguta; harĩ ndũrũme gĩcunjĩ kĩa igĩrĩ gĩa ikũmi;§
English: with their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil. You shall offer three tenths for a bull, and two tenths for the ram.

Kikuyu: na harĩ o gatũrũme gĩcunjĩ kĩmwe gĩa ikũmi.*
English: You shall offer one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;

Kikuyu: Na mũrutage thenge ĩmwe ĩrĩ igongona rĩa kũmũhoroheria mehia.
English: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you.

Kikuyu: Haaragĩriai icio hamwe na maruta ma rũciinĩ ma njino marĩa ma hĩndĩ ciothe.
English: You shall offer these in addition to the burnt offering of the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.

Kikuyu: Ũguo nĩguo mũrĩharagĩria irio cia gũcinwo na mwaki o mũthenya matukũ mũgwanja nĩguo ituĩke mũtararĩko mwega wa gũkenia Jehova; rĩrĩharagĩrio hamwe na igongona rĩa njino rĩa hĩndĩ ciothe na iruta rĩarĩo rĩa kũnyuuo.
English: In this way you shall offer daily, for seven days, the food of the offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh. It shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

Kikuyu: Mũthenya wa mũgwanja mũgĩage na kĩũngano kĩamũre, na mũtikarutage wĩra wa ndũire.
English: On the seventh day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.

Kikuyu: “ ‘Mũthenya wa kũruta maciaro ma mbere, rĩrĩa mũrehagĩra Jehova maruta ma ngano ya mũgethano hĩndĩ ya Gĩathĩ gĩa Ciumia-rĩ, gĩagai na kĩũngano kĩamũre, na mũtikarutage wĩra wa ndũire.
English: “ ‘Also in the day of the first fruits, when you offer a new meal offering to Yahweh in your feast of weeks, you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work;

Kikuyu: Rehagai igongona rĩa njino rĩa tũtegwa twĩrĩ, na ndũrũme ĩmwe, na tũtũrũme mũgwanja o kamwe ka ũkũrũ wa mwaka ũmwe, rĩtuĩke mũtararĩko mwega wa gũkenia Jehova.
English: but you shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old;

Kikuyu: Na harĩ o ndegwa hakorwo na iruta rĩa mũtu rĩa icunjĩ ithatũ cia ikũmi cia eba ĩmwe† ya mũtu mũhinyu mũno ũtukanĩtio na maguta; nayo ndũrũme ĩrutanĩrio na icunjĩ igĩrĩ cia ikũmi,‡
English: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenths for each bull, two tenths for the one ram,

Kikuyu: na gĩcunjĩ kĩmwe gĩa ikũmi§ kĩrutagwo harĩ o gatũrũme ga tũu mũgwanja.
English: one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;

Kikuyu: Mũcirutanĩrie na thenge ĩmwe ya kũmũhoroheria mehia.
English: and one male goat, to make atonement for you.

Kikuyu: Haaragĩriai icio hamwe na indo ciacio cia kũnyuuo, hamwe na igongona rĩa njino rĩa hĩndĩ ciothe na maruta marĩo ma mũtu. Na mũmenyagĩrĩre nyamũ icio itikanakorwo na kaũũgũ.
English: Besides the continual burnt offering and its meal offering, you shall offer them and their drink offerings. See that they are without defect.

Kikuyu: “ ‘Mũthenya wa mbere wa mweri wa mũgwanja, gĩagai na kĩũngano kĩamũre na mũtikarute wĩra wa ndũire. Nĩ mũthenya wanyu wa kũhuhaga tũrumbeta.
English: “ ‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no regular work. It is a day of blowing of trumpets to you.

Kikuyu: Haaragĩriai igongona rĩa njino, rĩa gategwa kamwe na ndũrũme ĩmwe na tũtũrũme mũgwanja o kamwe ka ũkũrũ wa mwaka ũmwe, ciothe itarĩ na kaũũgũ, irĩ ta mũtararĩko mwega wa gũkenia Jehova.
English: You shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect;

Kikuyu: Na harĩ o ndegwa ĩyo hakorwo na iruta rĩa mũtu icunjĩ ithatũ cia ikũmi cia eba ĩmwe* ya mũtu mũhinyu mũno ũtukanĩtio na maguta; nayo ndũrũme ĩrutanĩrio na icunjĩ igĩrĩ cia ikũmi;†
English: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for the bull, two tenths for the ram,

Kikuyu: na o gĩcunjĩ kĩmwe gĩa ikũmi‡ kĩrutagwo harĩ o gatũrũme ga tũu mũgwanja.
English: and one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;

Kikuyu: Mũcirutanĩrie na thenge ĩmwe ĩrĩ igongona rĩa kũmũhoroheria mehia.
English: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you;

Kikuyu: Icio nĩ cia kuongererwo harĩ magongona ma njino ma o mweri, na ma o mũthenya, hamwe na maruta macio ma mũtu na ma indo cia kũnyuuo o ta ũrĩa ũtuĩtwo. Macio nĩ maruta marutĩirwo Jehova macinĩtwo na mwaki, marĩ na mũtararĩko wa kũnunga wega.
English: in addition to the burnt offering of the new moon with its meal offering, and the continual burnt offering with its meal offering, and their drink offerings, according to their ordinance, for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

Kikuyu: “ ‘Mũthenya wa ikũmi wa mweri ũyũ wa mũgwanja, gĩagai na kĩũngano gĩtheru. No nginya mwĩimage irio na mũtikarute wĩra.
English: “ ‘On the tenth day of this seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall afflict your souls. You shall do no kind of work;

Kikuyu: Rehagai igongona rĩa njino rĩna mũtararĩko mwega wa gũkenia Jehova rĩa gategwa kamwe na ndũrũme ĩmwe, na tũtũrũme mũgwanja o kamwe ka ũkũrũ wa mwaka ũmwe, ciothe itarĩ na kaũũgũ.
English: but you shall offer a burnt offering to Yahweh for a pleasant aroma: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old, all without defect;

Kikuyu: Hamwe na ndegwa ĩyo haragĩriai iruta rĩa mũtu icunjĩ ithatũ cia ikũmi cia eba ĩmwe§ ya mũtu mũhinyu mũno ũtukanĩtio na maguta; nayo ndũrũme ĩrutanĩrio na icunjĩ igĩrĩ cia ikũmi;*
English: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for the bull, two tenths for the one ram,

Kikuyu: na gĩcunjĩ kĩmwe gĩa ikũmi† kĩrutagwo harĩ o gatũrũme ga tũu mũgwanja.
English: one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;

Kikuyu: Mũcirutanĩrie na thenge ĩmwe ĩrĩ igongona rĩa kũhoroheria mehia, yongererwo harĩ igongona rĩa horohio, naigongonarĩanjinorĩahĩndĩciothe, hamwenairutarĩamũtu, namarutamaomakũnyuuo.
English: one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and their drink offerings.

Kikuyu: “ ‘Mũthenya wa ikũmi na ĩtano mweri wa mũgwanja, gĩagai na kĩũngano kĩamũre na mũtikarute wĩra wa ndũire. Kũngũĩrai Jehova na gĩathĩ mĩthenya mũgwanja.
English: “ ‘On the fifteenth day of the seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work. You shall keep a feast to Yahweh seven days.

Kikuyu: Rehagai maruta ma gũcinwo na mwaki marĩ na mũtararĩko mwega wa gũkenia Jehova, igongona rĩa njino rĩa tũtegwa ikũmi na tũtatũ, na ndũrũme igĩrĩ, na tũtũrũme ikũmi na tũna o kamwe ka ũkũrũ wa mwaka ũmwe, ciothe itarĩ na kaũũgũ.
English: You shall offer a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: thirteen young bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect;

Kikuyu: Harĩ o ndegwa icio ikũmi na ithatũ-rĩ, haragĩriai iruta rĩa mũtu icunjĩ ithatũ cia ikũmi cia ebaĩmwe‡ ya mũtu mũhinyumũnoũtukanĩtiona maguta; harĩo ndũrũmeĩmwe ya icio igĩrĩ, irutanĩrio na icunjĩ igĩrĩ cia ikũmi;§
English: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for every bull of the thirteen bulls, two tenths for each ram of the two rams,

Kikuyu: na gĩcunjĩ kĩmwe gĩa ikũmi* kĩrutagwo harĩ o gatũrũme ga tũu ikũmi na tũna.
English: and one tenth for every lamb of the fourteen lambs;

Kikuyu: Mũcirutanĩrie na thenge ĩmwe ĩrĩ igongona rĩa kũhoroherio mehia, yongererwo harĩ igongona rĩa njino rĩa hĩndĩ ciothe, hamwe na iruta rĩa mũtu na iruta rĩa kũnyuuo.
English: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.

Kikuyu: “ ‘Mũthenya wa keerĩ, haaragĩriai tũtegwa ikũmi na twĩrĩ, na ndũrũme igĩrĩ, na tũtũrũme ikũmi na tũna o kamwe ka ũkũrũ wa mwaka ũmwe, ciothe itarĩ na kaũũgũ.
English: “ ‘On the second day you shall offer twelve young bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

Kikuyu: Hamwe na ndegwa na ndũrũme, na tũtũrũme tũu, haaragĩriai maruta macio ma mũtu na maruta ma kũnyuuo kũringana na mũigana ũrĩa ũtuĩtwo.
English: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

Kikuyu: Mũcirutanĩrie na thenge ĩmwe ĩrĩ igongona rĩa kũhoroherio mehia, yongererwo harĩ igongona rĩa njino rĩa hĩndĩ ciothe, hamwe na iruta rĩa mũtu na iruta rĩao rĩa kũnyuuo.
English: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, with its meal offering and their drink offerings.

Kikuyu: “ ‘Mũthenya wa gatatũ-rĩ, haaragĩriai ndegwa ikũmi na ĩmwe, na ndũrũme igĩrĩ, na tũtũrũme ikũmi na tũna o kamwe ka ũkũrũ wa mwaka ũmwe, ciothe itarĩ na kaũũgũ.
English: “ ‘On the third day: eleven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

Kikuyu: Hamwe na ndegwa, na ndũrũme, na tũtũrũme tũu, mũhaaragĩrieimaruta macio ma mũtu, na maruta ma kũnyuuokũringana na mũigana ũrĩa ũtuĩtwo.
English: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

Kikuyu: Mũcirutanĩrie na thenge ĩmwe ĩrĩ igongona rĩa kũhoroherio mehia, yongererwo harĩ igongona rĩa njino rĩa hĩndĩ ciothe, hamwe na iruta rĩa mũtu na iruta rĩa kũnyuuo.
English: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.

Kikuyu: “ ‘Mũthenya wa kana-rĩ, haaragĩriai ndegwa ikũmi, na ndũrũme igĩrĩ, na tũtũrũme ikũmi na tũna o kamwe ka ũkũrũ wa mwaka ũmwe, ciothe itarĩ na kaũũgũ.
English: “ ‘On the fourth day ten bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

Kikuyu: Hamwe na ndegwa, na ndũrũme, na tũtũrũme tũu, haaragĩriai maruta macio ma mũtu na maruta ma kũnyuuo kũringana na mũigana ũrĩa ũtuĩtwo.
English: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

Kikuyu: Mũcirutanĩrie na thenge ĩmwe ĩrĩ igongona rĩa kũhoroherio mehia, yongererwo harĩ igongona rĩa njino rĩa hĩndĩ ciothe, hamwe na iruta rĩa mũtu na iruta rĩa kũnyuuo.
English: and one male goat for a sin offering; in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.

Kikuyu: “ ‘Mũthenya wa gatano, haaragĩriai ndegwa kenda, na ndũrũme igĩrĩ, na tũtũrũme ikũmi na tũna o kamwe ka ũkũrũ wa mwaka ũmwe, ciothe itarĩ na kaũũgũ.
English: “ ‘On the fifth day: nine bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

Kikuyu: Hamwe na ndegwa na ndũrũme, na tũtũrũme tũu, haaragĩriai maruta macio ma mũtu na maruta ma kũnyuuo kũringana na mũigana ũrĩa ũtuĩtwo.
English: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance,

Kikuyu: Mũcirutanĩrie na thenge ĩmwe ĩrĩ igongona rĩa kũhoroherio mehia, yongererwo harĩ igongona rĩa njino rĩa hĩndĩ ciothe, hamwe na iruta rĩa kũnyuuo.
English: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.

Kikuyu: “ ‘Mũthenya wa gatandatũ-rĩ, haaragĩriai ndegwa inyanya, na ndũrũme igĩrĩ, na tũtũrũme ikũmi na tũna o kamwe ka ũkũrũ wa mwaka ũmwe, ciothe itarĩ na kaũũgũ.
English: “ ‘On the sixth day: eight bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

Kikuyu: Hamwe na ndegwa, na ndũrũme, na tũtũrũme tũu, haaragĩriai maruta macio ma mũtu na maruta ma kũnyuuo kũringana na mũigana ũrĩa ũtuĩtwo.
English: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance,

Kikuyu: Mũcirutanĩrie na thenge ĩmwe ĩrĩ igongona rĩa kũhoroherio mehia, yongererwo harĩ igongona rĩa njino rĩa hĩndĩ ciothe, hamwe na iruta rĩa mũtu na iruta rĩa kũnyuuo.
English: and one male goat for a sin offering; in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and the drink offerings of it.

Kikuyu: “ ‘Mũthenya wa mũgwanja, haaragĩriai ndegwa mũgwanja, na ndũrũme igĩrĩ, na tũtũrũme ikũmi na tũna o kamwe ka ũkũrũ wa mwaka ũmwe, ciothe itarĩ na kaũũgũ.
English: “ ‘On the seventh day: seven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

Kikuyu: Hamwe na ndegwa, na ndũrũme, na tũtũrũme tũu, haaragĩriai maruta macio ma mũtu na maruta ma kũnyuuo kũringana na mũigana ũrĩa ũtuĩtwo.
English: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance,

Kikuyu: Mũcirutanĩrie na thenge ĩmwe ĩrĩ igongona rĩa kũhoroherio mehia, yongererwo harĩ igongona rĩa njino rĩa hĩndĩ ciothe, hamwe na iruta rĩa mũtu na iruta rĩa kũnyuuo.
English: and one male goat for a sin offering; in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.

Kikuyu: “ ‘Mũthenya wa kanana-rĩ, gĩagai na kĩũngano na mũtikarute wĩra wa ndũire.
English: “ ‘On the eighth day you shall have a solemn assembly. You shall do no regular work;

Kikuyu: Rehagai iruta rĩa gũcinwo na mwaki rĩrĩ mũtararĩko mwega wa gũkenia Jehova, igongona rĩa njino rĩa ndegwa ĩmwe, na ndũrũme ĩmwe, na tũtũrũme mũgwanja o kamwe ka ũkũrũ wa mwaka ũmwe, ciothe itarĩ na kaũũgũ.
English: but you shall offer a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: one bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect;

Kikuyu: Hamwe na ndegwa, na ndũrũme, na tũtũrũme tũu, haaragĩriai maruta macio ma mũtu na maruta ma kũnyuuo kũringana na mũigana ũrĩa ũtuĩtwo.
English: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bull, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the ordinance,

Kikuyu: Mũcirutanĩrie na thenge ĩmwe ĩrĩ igongona rĩa kũhoroherio mehia, yongererwo harĩ igongona rĩa njino rĩa hĩndĩ ciothe, hamwe na iruta rĩa mũtu na iruta rĩa kũnyuuo.
English: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, with its meal offering, and its drink offering.

Kikuyu: “ ‘Hamwe na mwĩhĩtwa na maruta manyu ma kwĩyendera-rĩ, haaragĩriai indo icio nĩ ũndũ wa Jehova ciathĩ-inĩ cianyu iria ciathanĩtwo: na nĩcio maruta manyu ma njino, na maruta ma mũtu, na maruta ma kũnyuuo, na maruta ma ũiguano.’ ”
English: “ ‘You shall offer these to Yahweh in your set feasts—in addition to your vows and your free will offerings—for your burnt offerings, your meal offerings, your drink offerings, and your peace offerings.’ ”

Kikuyu: Musa akĩĩra andũ a Isiraeli maũndũ marĩa mothe Jehova aamwathĩte.
English: Moses told the children of Israel according to all that Yahweh commanded Moses.

Kikuyu: Musa akĩĩra atongoria a mĩhĩrĩga ya Isiraeli atĩrĩ: “Ũũ nĩguo Jehova aathanĩte:
English: Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel, saying, “This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded.

Kikuyu: Rĩrĩa mũndũ angĩĩhĩta mwĩhĩtwa harĩ Jehova kana ehĩte mwĩhĩtwa wa kwĩhinga mũhingo na ũndũ wa kĩĩranĩro, ndakanericũkwo, na no nginya eke maũndũ marĩa mothe ehĩtĩte.
English: When a man vows a vow to Yahweh, or swears an oath to bind his soul with a bond, he shall not break his word. He shall do according to all that proceeds out of his mouth.

Kikuyu: “Rĩrĩa mũirĩtu ũrĩ gwa ithe mũciĩ angĩĩhĩta mwĩhĩtwa kũrĩ Jehova, kana ehinge na mũhingo na ũndũ wa kĩĩranĩro,
English: “Also, when a woman vows a vow to Yahweh and binds herself by a pledge, being in her father’s house, in her youth,

Kikuyu: nake ithe aigue ũhoro wa mwĩhĩtwa ũcio wake, kana kĩĩranĩro kĩu, no aage kũmwĩra ũndũ hĩndĩ ĩyo, mĩĩhĩtwa yake yothe, na kĩĩranĩro kĩrĩa gĩothe ehingĩte nakĩo we mwene, nĩigatũũra.
English: and her father hears her vow and her pledge with which she has bound her soul, and her father says nothing to her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge with which she has bound her soul shall stand.

Kikuyu: No ithe angĩmũkaania aigua ũhoro wa mĩĩhĩtwa ĩyo, hatirĩ o na kĩmwe kĩa mĩĩhĩtwa ĩyo yake, kana ciĩranĩro icio ehingĩte nacio we mwene, igatũũra; nake Jehova nĩakamũrekera nĩ ũndũ ithe nĩamũgirĩtie eke ũndũ ũcio.
English: But if her father forbids her in the day that he hears, none of her vows or of her pledges with which she has bound her soul, shall stand. Yahweh will forgive her, because her father has forbidden her.

Kikuyu: “No angĩhika arĩkĩtie kwĩhĩta, kana thuutha wa kwĩranĩra ũndũ na kanua gake ateciirĩtie ũhoro wa kĩĩranĩro kĩu ehingĩte nakĩo,
English: “If she has a husband, while her vows are on her, or the rash utterance of her lips with which she has bound her soul,

Kikuyu: nake mũthuuriwe aigue ũhoro ũcio na aage kũmwĩra ũndũ, hĩndĩ ĩyo mĩĩhĩtwa yake kana ciĩranĩro icio ehingĩte nacio we mwene nĩigatũũra.
English: and her husband hears it, and says nothing to her in the day that he hears it; then her vows shall stand, and her pledges with which she has bound her soul shall stand.

Kikuyu: No mũthuuriwe angĩmũkaania rĩrĩa aigua ũhoro wa mĩĩhĩtwa ĩyo, nĩakeheria mwĩhĩtwa ũcio ũmuohete, kana kĩĩranĩro kĩrĩa ehingĩte nakĩo we mwene ateciirĩtie, nake Jehova nĩakamũrekera.
English: But if her husband forbids her in the day that he hears it, then he makes void her vow which is on her and the rash utterance of her lips, with which she has bound her soul. Yahweh will forgive her.

Kikuyu: “Mwĩhĩtwa o wothe kana ũndũ ũrĩa mũtumia wa ndigwa kana mũtumia ũrĩa ũtiganĩte na mũthuuriwe angĩkorwo ehĩtĩte nĩatũũre aũrũmĩtie.
English: “But the vow of a widow, or of her who is divorced, everything with which she has bound her soul shall stand against her.

Kikuyu: “Mũtumia ũrĩ na mũthuuriwe angĩĩhĩta kana ehinge we mwene na kĩĩranĩro kĩa mwĩhĩtwa,
English: “If she vowed in her husband’s house or bound her soul by a bond with an oath,

Kikuyu: nakemũthuuriweaigueũhoroũcio, noaagekũmwĩraũndũkanaaagekũmũgiria, hĩndĩĩyomĩĩhĩtwa yake yothe, kana ciĩranĩro iria ehingĩte nacio we mwene, nĩigatũũra.
English: and her husband heard it, and held his peace at her and didn’t disallow her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge with which she bound her soul shall stand.

Kikuyu: No mũthuuriwe angĩregana na ũhoro ũcio hĩndĩ ĩyo aũigua-rĩ, hatirĩ o na kĩmwe kĩa mĩĩhĩtwa kana ciĩranĩro iria ciumĩte kanua gake igaatũũra. Mũthuuriwe nĩareganĩte nacio, nake Jehova nĩakamũrekera.
English: But if her husband made them null and void in the day that he heard them, then whatever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand. Her husband has made them void. Yahweh will forgive her.

Kikuyu: Mũthuuriwe no etĩkĩre kana aregane na mwĩhĩtwa o wothe ũrĩa angĩĩhĩta kana kĩĩranĩro kĩrĩa eranĩire na mwĩhĩtwa gĩa kwĩrega we mwene.
English: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.

Kikuyu: No mũthuuriwe angĩaga kũmwĩra ũndũ igũrũ rĩa ũhoro ũcio mũthenya o mũthenya, nĩetĩkĩrĩte mĩĩhĩtwa yake kana ciĩranĩro iria imuohete. Nĩetĩkĩrĩte maũndũ macio nĩ ũndũ wa kwaga kũmwĩra ũndũ rĩrĩa aigua ũhoro ũcio.
English: But if her husband says nothing to her from day to day, then he establishes all her vows or all her pledges which are on her. He has established them, because he said nothing to her in the day that he heard them.

Kikuyu: No angĩrega maũndũ macio thuutha hanini, aarĩkia kũmaigua, nĩwe ũngĩcookererwo nĩ mahĩtia ma mũtumia wake.”
English: But if he makes them null and void after he has heard them, then he shall bear her iniquity.”

Kikuyu: Macio nĩmo mawatho marĩa Jehova aaheire Musa makoniĩ mũndũ na mũtumia wake, na makoniĩ ithe na mwarĩ ũrĩa ũrĩ gwake mũciĩ.
English: These are the statutes which Yahweh commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between a father and his daughter, being in her youth, in her father’s house.

Kikuyu: Nake Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ:
English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

Kikuyu: “Rĩhĩria andũ a Isiraeli harĩ andũ a Midiani. Na thuutha ũcio nĩũgũcooka ũkue.”
English: “Avenge the children of Israel on the Midianites. Afterward you shall be gathered to your people.”

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Musa akĩĩra andũ acio atĩrĩ, “Andũ amwe anyu nĩmeohe indo ciao cia mbaara mathiĩ makahũũrane na andũ a Midiani nĩguo marĩhĩrie Jehova kũrĩ o.
English: Moses spoke to the people, saying, “Arm men from among you for war, that they may go against Midian, to execute Yahweh’s vengeance on Midian.

Kikuyu: Tũmai andũ 1,000 kuuma kũrĩ o mũhĩrĩga wa Isiraeli mbaara-inĩ.”
English: You shall send one thousand out of every tribe, throughout all the tribes of Israel, to the war.”

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio andũ 12,000 meeohete indo cia mbaara, o 1,000 kuuma kũrĩ o mũhĩrĩga, makĩneanwo kuuma mĩhĩrĩga ya Isiraeli.
English: So there were delivered, out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand from every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.

Kikuyu: Musa akĩmatũma mbaara-inĩ, o 1,000 kuuma harĩ o mũhĩrĩga, marĩ hamwe na Finehasi mũrũ wa Eleazaru ũrĩa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai, ũrĩa wakuuire indo cia handũ-harĩa-haamũre, o na tũrumbeta twa kũhuhwo.
English: Moses sent them, one thousand of every tribe, to the war with Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets for the alarm in his hand.

Kikuyu: Nao makĩhũũrana na andũ a Midiani o ta ũrĩa Jehova aathĩte Musa, na makĩũraga arũme othe.
English: They fought against Midian, as Yahweh commanded Moses. They killed every male.

Kikuyu: Gatagatĩ ka arĩa mooragire nĩ Evi, na Rekemu, na Zuru, na Huri, na Reba, athamaki arĩa atano a Midiani. O na ningĩ nĩmooragire Balamu mũrũ wa Beori na rũhiũ rwa njora.
English: They killed the kings of Midian with the rest of their slain: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam the son of Beor with the sword.

Kikuyu: Nao andũ a Isiraeli magĩtaha andũ-a-nja a Midiani na ciana, na magĩkuua ndũũru ciothe cia andũ a Midiani cia ngʼombe na cia mbũri, na magĩtaha indo iria ingĩ ciothe.
English: The children of Israel took the women of Midian captive with their little ones; and all their livestock, all their flocks, and all their goods, they took as plunder.

Kikuyu: Magĩcina matũũra mothe kũrĩa andũ a Midiani maatũũrĩte, o ũndũ ũmwe na kambĩ ciao.
English: All their cities in the places in which they lived, and all their encampments, they burned with fire.

Kikuyu: Magĩkuua indo ciothe iria maatahĩte na iria maatunyanĩte hamwe na andũ na nyamũ,
English: They took all the captives, and all the plunder, both of man and of animal.

Kikuyu: na magĩtwara andũ arĩa matahĩtwo na indo icio maatunyanĩte, na iria maatahĩte kũrĩ Musa na kũrĩ Eleazaru ũrĩa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai na kũrĩ kĩũngano kĩa andũ a Isiraeli kũu kambĩ yarĩ werũ-inĩ wa Moabi, hũgũrũrũ-inĩ cia Rũũĩ rwa Jorodani mũrĩmo wa Jeriko.
English: They brought the captives with the prey and the plunder, to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of the children of Israel, to the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by the Jordan at Jericho.

Kikuyu: Musa, na Eleazaru ũrĩa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai na atongoria othe a kĩrĩndĩ magĩthiĩ kũmatũnga nja ya kambĩ.
English: Moses and Eleazar the priest, with all the princes of the congregation, went out to meet them outside of the camp.

Kikuyu: Musa akĩrakarĩra anene a mbũtũ icio cia ita na atongoria a mbũtũ cia o ngiri, ngiri, na atongoria a mbũtũ cia o igana, igana, arĩa moimĩte mbaara-inĩ.
English: Moses was angry with the officers of the army, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds, who came from the service of the war.

Kikuyu: Akĩmooria atĩrĩ, “Kaĩ mwĩtĩkĩrĩtie andũ a nja othe matũũre muoyo?
English: Moses said to them, “Have you saved all the women alive?

Kikuyu: Acio nĩo maarũmĩrĩire mataaro ma Balamu, na nĩo maatũmire andũ a Isiraeli matirike Jehova ũhoro-inĩ ũrĩa wekĩkire kũu Peori, naguo ũndũ ũcio ũkĩrehithĩria andũ a Jehova mũthiro.
English: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against Yahweh in the matter of Peor, and so the plague was among the congregation of Yahweh.

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio, ũragai tũhĩĩ tuothe. Na ningĩ mũũrage mũndũ-wa-nja wothe ũrĩ wakoma na mũndũ mũrũme,
English: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman who has known man by lying with him.

Kikuyu: no mwĩhonokerie mũirĩtu o wothe ũrĩa ũtarĩ wakoma na mũndũ mũrũme.
English: But all the girls, who have not known man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.

Kikuyu: “Inyuothe arĩa mũũragĩte mũndũ o wothe kana mũkahutia mũndũ o wothe mũũrage no nginya mũikare nja ya kambĩ mĩthenya mũgwanja. Mũthenya wa ĩtatũ na wa mũgwanja, no nginya mwĩtherie inyuĩ ene na arĩa mũtahĩte.
English: “Encamp outside of the camp for seven days. Whoever has killed any person, and whoever has touched any slain, purify yourselves on the third day and on the seventh day, you and your captives.

Kikuyu: Theriai nguo ciothe, o ũndũ ũmwe na kĩndũ gĩothe gĩthondeketwo na rũũa, kana guoya wa mbũri kana mbaũ.”
English: You shall purify every garment, and all that is made of skin, and all work of goats’ hair, and all things made of wood.”

Kikuyu: Ningĩ Eleazaru ũrĩa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai akĩĩra thigari iria ciathiĩte mbaara-inĩ atĩrĩ, “Watho ũrĩa Jehova aaheire Musa uugĩte atĩrĩ:
English: Eleazar the priest said to the men of war who went to the battle, “This is the statute of the law which Yahweh has commanded Moses.

Kikuyu: Thahabu, na betha, na gĩcango, na kĩgera, na ibati, na rũbũũa
English: However the gold, and the silver, the bronze, the iron, the tin, and the lead,

Kikuyu: na kĩndũ o gĩothe kĩngĩhota gwĩtiiria mwaki, no nginya kĩhĩtũkagĩrio mwaki-inĩ nĩgeetha gĩthirwo nĩ thaahu. No rĩrĩ, no nginya gĩcooke gĩtherio na maaĩ marĩa ma kũniina thaahu. Nakĩo kĩndũ gĩothe gĩtangĩĩtiiria mwaki no nginya kĩhĩtũkĩrio maaĩ-inĩ macio.
English: everything that may withstand the fire, you shall make to go through the fire, and it shall be clean; nevertheless it shall be purified with the water for impurity. All that doesn’t withstand the fire you shall make to go through the water.

Kikuyu: Mũthenya wa mũgwanja-rĩ, thambiai nguo cianyu na inyuĩ nĩ mũgaathirwo nĩ thaahu. Thuutha ũcio no mũtoonye kambĩ.”
English: You shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and you shall be clean. Afterward you shall come into the camp.”

Kikuyu: Nake Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ,
English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

Kikuyu: “Wee na Eleazaru ũrĩa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai na atongoria a nyũmba cia kĩrĩndĩ gĩkĩ no nginya mũtare andũ othe na nyamũ iria ciatahirwo.
English: “Count the plunder that was taken, both of man and of animal, you, and Eleazar the priest, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the congregation;

Kikuyu: Gayaniai indo cia iria ndahe gatagatĩ ga thigari iria ciathiĩte mbaara-inĩ na kĩrĩndĩ kĩrĩa kĩngĩ.
English: and divide the plunder into two parts: between the men skilled in war, who went out to battle, and all the congregation.

Kikuyu: Kuuma kũrĩ thigari iria ciarũire mbaara, rutai gĩcunjĩ kĩa Jehova, kĩndũ kĩmwe thĩinĩ wa indo magana matano, marĩ andũ, kana ngʼombe, kana ndigiri, kana ngʼondu, o na kana mbũri.
English: Levy a tribute to Yahweh of the men of war who went out to battle: one soul of five hundred; of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks.

Kikuyu: Oya gĩcunjĩ gĩkĩ kuuma harĩ nuthu ya igai rĩao mũkĩnengere Eleazaru ũrĩa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai kĩrĩ gĩcunjĩ kĩa Jehova.
English: Take it from their half, and give it to Eleazar the priest, for Yahweh’s wave offering.

Kikuyu: Kuuma kũrĩ nuthu ya gĩcunjĩ kĩa andũ a Isiraeli, thuura kĩndũ kĩmwe kuuma harĩ o gĩkundi kĩa mĩrongo ĩtano, kĩrĩ kĩa andũ, kana ngʼombe, kana ndigiri, kana ngʼondu, kana mbũri o na kana nyamũ ingĩ. Cinengere Alawii arĩa wĩra wao ũrĩ kũmenyerera Hema-ĩrĩa-Nyamũre ya Jehova.”
English: Of the children of Israel’s half, you shall take one drawn out of every fifty, of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks, of all the livestock, and give them to the Levites, who perform the duty of Yahweh’s tabernacle.”

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Musa na Eleazaru ũrĩa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai magĩĩka o ta ũrĩa Jehova aathĩte Musa.
English: Moses and Eleazar the priest did as Yahweh commanded Moses.

Kikuyu: Indo cia gũtahwo cia iria ciatigarĩte kuuma kũrĩ indo iria ciatunyanĩtwo nĩ thigari ciarĩ ngʼondu 675,000,
English: Now the plunder, over and above the booty which the men of war took, was six hundred seventy-five thousand sheep,

Kikuyu: na ngʼombe 72,000,
English: seventy-two thousand head of cattle,

Kikuyu: na ndigiri 61,000
English: sixty-one thousand donkeys,

Kikuyu: na andũ-a-nja 32,000 arĩa mataakomete na mũndũ mũrũme.
English: and thirty-two thousand persons in all, of the women who had not known man by lying with him.

Kikuyu: Nuthu ya igai rĩa andũ arĩa maarũĩte mbaara-inĩ ciarĩ: ngʼondu 337,500,
English: The half, which was the portion of those who went out to war, was in number three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep;

Kikuyu: na kuuma harĩ icio Jehova akĩrutĩrwo ngʼondu 675;
English: and Yahweh’s tribute of the sheep was six hundred seventy-five.

Kikuyu: nacio ngʼombe ciarĩ 36,000 na kuuma harĩ icio Jehova akĩrutĩrwo ngʼombe 72;
English: The cattle were thirty-six thousand, of which Yahweh’s tribute was seventy-two.

Kikuyu: nacio ndigiri ciarĩ 30,500, na kuuma harĩ icio Jehova akĩrutĩrwo ndigiri 61;
English: The donkeys were thirty thousand five hundred, of which Yahweh’s tribute was sixty-one.

Kikuyu: andũ maarĩ 16,000, na kuuma kũrĩ o Jehova akĩrutĩrwo andũ 32.
English: The persons were sixteen thousand, of whom Yahweh’s tribute was thirty-two persons.

Kikuyu: Musa akĩnengera Eleazaru ũrĩa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai gĩcunjĩ kĩa Jehova, o ta ũrĩa Jehova aathĩte Musa.
English: Moses gave the tribute, which was Yahweh’s wave offering, to Eleazar the priest, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

Kikuyu: Nuthu ĩrĩa yarĩ ya andũ a Isiraeli, ĩrĩa Musa aamũranĩtie na arĩa maathiĩte mbaara-inĩ,
English: Of the children of Israel’s half, which Moses divided off from the men who fought

Kikuyu: nuthu ĩrĩa yaheirwo kĩrĩndĩ ciarĩ ngʼondu 337,500,
English: (now the congregation’s half was three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep,

Kikuyu: nacio ngʼombe ciarĩ 36,000,
English: thirty-six thousand head of cattle,

Kikuyu: nacio ndigiri ciarĩ 30,500,
English: thirty thousand five hundred donkeys,

Kikuyu: nao andũ maarĩ 16,000.
English: and sixteen thousand persons),

Kikuyu: Kuuma kũrĩ nuthu ĩrĩa yaheirwo andũ a Isiraeli, Musa agĩthuura mũndũ ũmwe kuuma kũrĩ andũ mĩrongo ĩtano, na nyamũ ĩmwe kuuma kũrĩ nyamũ mĩrongo ĩtano, o ta ũrĩa Jehova aamwathĩte, na agĩcihe Alawii arĩa wĩra wao warĩ kũmenyerera Hema-ĩrĩa-Nyamũre ya Jehova.
English: even of the children of Israel’s half, Moses took one drawn out of every fifty, both of man and of animal, and gave them to the Levites, who performed the duty of Yahweh’s tabernacle, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ anene arĩa matongoragia mbũtũ cia ita, acio maathaga ikundi cia o ngiri ngiri, na ikundi cia o igana igana, magĩthiĩ harĩ Musa,
English: The officers who were over the thousands of the army, the captains of thousands, and the captains of hundreds, came near to Moses.

Kikuyu: nao makĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Ndungata ciaku nĩitarĩte thigari iria twathaga na hatirĩ o na ũmwe ũtarĩ ho.
English: They said to Moses, “Your servants have taken the sum of the men of war who are under our command, and there lacks not one man of us.

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio nĩtwarehe indo ici cia thahabu ituĩke iruta riitũ kũrĩ Jehova iria o ũmwe witũ eegwatĩire, nacio nĩ icũhĩ cia moko na bangiri cia moko, na icũhĩ cia ciara, na cia matũ, na mĩgathĩ ya ngingo, nĩguo twĩhoroherie mbere ya Jehova.”
English: We have brought Yahweh’s offering, what every man found: gold ornaments, armlets, bracelets, signet rings, earrings, and necklaces, to make atonement for our souls before Yahweh.”

Kikuyu: Musa na Eleazaru ũrĩa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai makĩamũkĩra thahabu ĩyo kuuma kũrĩ o, indo icio ciothe ciaturĩtwo wega.
English: Moses and Eleazar the priest took their gold, even all worked jewels.

Kikuyu: Thahabu yothe ĩrĩa yoimire kũrĩ anene a ikundi cia o ngiri, ngiri na anene a ikundi cia o igana, igana ĩrĩa Musa na Eleazaru maatwarĩire Jehova kĩrĩ kĩheo, yarĩ ya ũritũ wa cekeri 16,750.*
English: All the gold of the wave offering that they offered up to Yahweh, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred fifty shekels.†

Kikuyu: O mũthigari nĩetahĩire indo ciake.
English: The men of war had taken booty, every man for himself.

Kikuyu: Musa na Eleazaru ũrĩa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai makĩamũkĩra thahabu ĩyo kuuma kũrĩ anene a ikundi cia o ngiri, ngiri na anene a ikundi cia o igana, igana magĩcirehe Hema- inĩ ya Gũtũnganwo ituĩke kĩririkania harĩ andũ a Isiraeli mbere ya Jehova.
English: Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the Tent of Meeting for a memorial for the children of Israel before Yahweh.

Kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, andũ a mĩhĩrĩga ya Rubeni na Gadi, arĩa maarĩ na ndũũru nene cia ngʼombe na cia mbũri, nĩmoonire atĩ mabũrũri ma Jazeri na Gileadi maarĩ mega na mahiũ mao.
English: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of livestock. They saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead. Behold, the place was a place for livestock.

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio magĩthiĩ kũrĩ Musa na Eleazaru ũrĩa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai, o na kũrĩ atongoria a kĩrĩndĩ, makiuga atĩrĩ,
English: Then the children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spoke to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the princes of the congregation, saying,

Kikuyu: “Atarothu, na Diboni, na Jazeri, na Nimura, na Heshiboni, na Eleale, na Sebamu, na Nebo, o na Beoni,
English: “Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon,

Kikuyu: bũrũri ũyũ Jehova aatooririe andũ akuo mbere ya andũ a Isiraeli, nĩ kũndũ kwega kwa mahiũ, na ithuĩ ndungata ciaku tũrĩ na mahiũ.”
English: the land which Yahweh struck before the congregation of Israel, is a land for livestock; and your servants have livestock.”

Kikuyu: Makiuga atĩrĩ, “Angĩkorwo nĩtwĩtĩkĩrĩkĩte harĩ inyuĩ-rĩ, rekei bũrũri ũyũ ũheo ndungata cianyu ũtuĩke witũ. Mũtigatũme tũringe Rũũĩ rwa Jorodani.”
English: They said, “If we have found favor in your sight, let this land be given to your servants for a possession. Don’t bring us over the Jordan.”

Kikuyu: Musa akĩũria andũ a Gadi na a Rubeni atĩrĩ, “Andũ anyu no mathiĩ ita-inĩ mamũtige mũikarĩte gũkũ?
English: Moses said to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, “Shall your brothers go to war while you sit here?

Kikuyu: Nĩ kĩĩ gĩgũtũma mũũrage ngoro cia andũ a Isiraeli nĩguo matikaringe rũũĩ matoonye bũrũri ũrĩa Jehova amaheete?
English: Why do you discourage the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which Yahweh has given them?

Kikuyu: Ũguo noguo maithe manyu meekire hĩndĩ ĩrĩa ndaamarekirie kuuma Kadeshi-Barinea mathiĩ magathigaane bũrũri ũcio.
English: Your fathers did so when I sent them from Kadesh Barnea to see the land.

Kikuyu: Thuutha wa kwambata, magĩkinya kĩanda kĩa Eshikoli na makĩĩrorera bũrũri ũcio-rĩ, nĩmatũmire andũ a Isiraeli makue ngoro makĩaga gũtoonya bũrũri ũrĩa Jehova amaheete.
English: For when they went up to the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which Yahweh had given them.

Kikuyu: Jehova agĩcinwo nĩ marakara mũthenya ũcio, akĩĩhĩta na mwĩhĩtwa ũyũ:
English: Yahweh’s anger burned in that day, and he swore, saying,

Kikuyu: ‘Nĩ ũndũ nĩmagĩte kũnũmĩrĩra na ngoro ciao kũna, hatirĩ mũndũ o na ũmwe wa ũkũrũ wa mĩaka mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na makĩria wa arĩa moimire bũrũri wa Misiri ũkoona bũrũri ũrĩa nderĩire Iburahĩmu na Isaaka, o na Jakubu na mwĩhĩtwa,
English: ‘Surely none of the men who came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me,

Kikuyu: gũtirĩ o na ũmwe tiga Kalebu mũrũ wa Jefune, ũrĩa Mũkenizi,* na Joshua mũrũ wa Nuni, nĩ ũndũ nĩmarũmĩrĩire Jehova na ngoro ciao kũna.’
English: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, and Joshua the son of Nun, because they have followed Yahweh completely.’

Kikuyu: Jehova agĩcinwo nĩ marakara nĩ ũndũ wa Isiraeli, nake agĩtũma morũũre werũ-inĩ mĩaka mĩrongo ĩna, o nginya rĩrĩa rũciaro rũu ruothe rwehĩtie maitho-inĩ make rwathirire.
English: Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he made them wander back and forth in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation who had done evil in Yahweh’s sight was consumed.

Kikuyu: “Na rĩrĩ, mũrĩ haha inyuĩ, inyuĩ rũciaro rũrũ rwa ehia, mũcookete ithenya rĩa maithe manyu nĩguo mũtũme Jehova akĩrĩrĩrie kũrakarĩra Isiraeli.
English: “Behold, you have risen up in your fathers’ place, an increase of sinful men, to increase the fierce anger of Yahweh toward Israel.

Kikuyu: Mũngĩgarũrũka mũtige kũmũrũmĩrĩra-rĩ, nake Jehova nĩegũtiganĩria andũ aya othe gũkũ werũ-inĩ rĩngĩ, na inyuĩ mũtuĩke gĩtũmi gĩa kũmaniinithia.”
English: For if you turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and you will destroy all these people.”

Kikuyu: Nao magĩthiĩ kũrĩ Musa makĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Ithuĩ tũkwenda gwakĩra ũhiũ witũ ciugũ gũkũ, na twakĩre andũ-a-nja aitũ na ciana matũũra manene.
English: They came near to him, and said, “We will build sheepfolds here for our livestock, and cities for our little ones;

Kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, nĩtwĩhaarĩirie kuoya indo ciitũ cia mbaara na tũthiĩ mbere ya andũ a Isiraeli nginya tũmakinyie kwao. Hĩndĩ ĩyo, andũ-a-nja aitũ na ciana maikarage matũũra manene mairigĩre na hinya, nĩgeetha magitĩrwo kuuma kũrĩ atũũri a bũrũri ũyũ.
English: but we ourselves will be ready armed to go before the children of Israel, until we have brought them to their place. Our little ones shall dwell in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.

Kikuyu: Tũtigacooka mĩciĩ iitũ o nginya hĩndĩ ĩrĩa Mũisiraeli o wothe akaamũkĩra igai rĩake.
English: We will not return to our houses until the children of Israel have all received their inheritance.

Kikuyu: Ithuĩ tũtikaamũkĩra igai hamwe nao mũrĩmo ũrĩa ũngĩ wa Jorodani, nĩ ũndũ igai riitũ tũrĩ narĩo mwena wa irathĩro wa Rũũĩ rwa Jorodani.”
English: For we will not inherit with them on the other side of the Jordan and beyond, because our inheritance has come to us on this side of the Jordan eastward.”

Kikuyu: Nake Musa akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Mũngĩĩka ũguo-rĩ, na mwĩohe indo cianyu cia mbaara mbere ya Jehova nĩguo mũkarũe,
English: Moses said to them: “If you will do this thing, if you will arm yourselves to go before Yahweh to the war,

Kikuyu: na inyuothe mũngĩthiĩ mwĩohete indo cia mbaara, mũringe Rũũĩ rwa Jorodani mũrĩ mbere ya Jehova o nginya rĩrĩa akaingata thũ ciake ciume mbere yake,
English: and every one of your armed men will pass over the Jordan before Yahweh until he has driven out his enemies from before him,

Kikuyu: hĩndĩ ĩrĩa bũrũri ũcio ũgaakorwo ũtooretio mbere ya Jehova, hĩndĩ ĩyo no mũcooke mĩciĩ yanyu na muohorwo kuuma kĩĩranĩro kĩanyu kũrĩ Jehova o na kũrĩ Isiraeli. Naguo bũrũri ũyũ nĩũgatuĩka wanyu maitho-inĩ ma Jehova.
English: and the land is subdued before Yahweh; then afterward you shall return, and be clear of obligation to Yahweh and to Israel. Then this land shall be your possession before Yahweh.

Kikuyu: “No mũngĩkaaga gwĩka ũguo, nĩmũkehĩria Jehova; na mũmenye na ma atĩ mehia manyu nĩmakamũcookerera.
English: “But if you will not do so, behold, you have sinned against Yahweh; and be sure your sin will find you out.

Kikuyu: Akĩrai andũ-a-nja anyu na ciana matũũra manene na ciugũ cia ndũũru cianyu, no hingiai ũguo mweranĩra.”
English: Build cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which has proceeded out of your mouth.”

Kikuyu: Andũ a Gadi na a Rubeni makĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ, “Ithuĩ ndungata ciaku nĩtũgwĩka o ta ũguo mwathi witũ aathana.
English: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben spoke to Moses, saying, “Your servants will do as my lord commands.

Kikuyu: Ciana ciitũ na atumia aitũ megũikara gũkũ matũũra-inĩ manene ma Gileadi, ũndũ ũmwe na ndũũru ciitũ cia mbũri na cia ngʼombe.
English: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our livestock shall be there in the cities of Gilead;

Kikuyu: No ithuĩ ndungata ciaku-rĩ, o mũndũ eyohete indo ciake cia mbaara, nĩtũkũringa mũrĩmo ũũrĩa tũkarũe tũrĩ mbere ya Jehova, o ta ũguo mwathi witũ oiga.”
English: but your servants will pass over, every man who is armed for war, before Yahweh to battle, as my lord says.”

Kikuyu: Nake Musa akĩruta watho nĩ ũndũ wao, akĩarĩria Eleazaru ũrĩa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai, na Joshua mũrũ wa Nuni, na atongoria a nyũmba cia mĩhĩrĩga ya andũ a Isiraeli,
English: So Moses commanded concerning them to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of the fathers’ households of the tribes of the children of Israel.

Kikuyu: akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Angĩkorwo andũ a Gadi na a Rubeni nĩmekũringa Jorodani, o mũndũ wao eyohete indo cia mbaara, marĩ hamwe na inyuĩ marĩ mbere ya Jehova-rĩ, hĩndĩ ĩrĩa bũrũri ũcio ũgatoorio mbere yanyu, nĩmũkamahe bũrũri wa Gileadi ũtuĩke wao.
English: Moses said to them, “If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over the Jordan, every man who is armed to battle before Yahweh, and the land is subdued before you, then you shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession;

Kikuyu: No mangĩaga kũringa hamwe na inyuĩ meeohete indo ciao cia mbaara, no nginya metĩkĩre igai rĩao hamwe na inyuĩ bũrũri wa Kaanani.”
English: but if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.”

Kikuyu: Andũ a Gadi na a Rubeni makĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Ndungata ciaku nĩ igwĩka o ta ũguo Jehova oigĩte.
English: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, “As Yahweh has said to your servants, so will we do.

Kikuyu: Nĩtũkũringa tũrĩ mbere ya Jehova tũtoonye bũrũri wa Kaanani twĩohete indo cia mbaara, no kũndũ kũrĩa ithuĩ tũkaagaya-rĩ, gũgaakorwo kũrĩ mbarĩ ĩno ya Jorodani.”
English: We will pass over armed before Yahweh into the land of Canaan, and the possession of our inheritance shall remain with us beyond the Jordan.”

Kikuyu: Musa akĩhe andũ a Gadi na a Rubeni na nuthu ya mũhĩrĩga wa Manase mũrũ wa Jusufu, bũrũri ũrĩa wothe wathamakagwo nĩ Sihoni mũthamaki wa Aamori, na ũrĩa wothe wathamakagwo nĩ Ogu mũthamaki wa Bashani, akĩmahe bũrũri ũcio wothe, na matũũra manene makuo o na ngʼongo iria ciamarigiicĩirie.
English: Moses gave to them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan; the land, according to its cities and borders, even the cities of the surrounding land.

Kikuyu: Andũ a Gadi nĩmakire Diboni, na Atarothu, na Aroeri,
English: The children of Gad built Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,

Kikuyu: na Atarothu-Shofani, na Jazeri, na Jogibeha,
English: Atroth-shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,

Kikuyu: na Bethi-Nimira, na Bethi-Harani, maarĩ matũũra manene mairigĩre na hinya na magĩakĩra ndũũru ciao cia mbũri ciugũ.
English: Beth Nimrah, and Beth Haran: fortified cities and folds for sheep.

Kikuyu: Nao andũ a Rubeni magĩaka Heshiboni, na Eleale, na Kiriathaimu rĩngĩ,
English: The children of Reuben built Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,

Kikuyu: o ũndũ ũmwe na Nebo na Baali-Meoni (marĩĩtwa macio nĩmagarũrirwo) na Sibima. Nao makĩhe matũũra macio manene maakire marĩĩtwa mangĩ.
English: Nebo, and Baal Meon, (their names being changed), and Sibmah. They gave other names to the cities which they built.

Kikuyu: Nacio njiaro cia Makiru mũrũ wa Manase igĩthiĩ Gileadi, magĩkwĩnyiitĩra na makĩingata Aamori arĩa maarĩ kuo.
English: The children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, took it, and dispossessed the Amorites who were therein.

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Musa akĩheana Gileadi kũrĩ andũ a Makiru, acio njiaro cia Manase, nao magĩtũũra kuo.
English: Moses gave Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh; and he lived therein.

Kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, Jairu wa rũciaro rwa Manase, akĩĩnyiitĩra tũtũũra twa Gileadi na agĩtwĩta Havothu-Jairu.
English: Jair the son of Manasseh went and took its villages, and called them Havvoth Jair.

Kikuyu: Nake Noba akĩĩnyiitĩra Kenathu, na tũtũũra tũrĩa twagũthiũrũrũkĩirie agĩtwĩta Noba, o ta ũrĩa we eetagwo.
English: Nobah went and took Kenath and its villages, and called it Nobah, after his own name.

Kikuyu: Maya nĩmo matĩĩna ma rũgendo rwa andũ a Isiraeli rĩrĩa moimire bũrũri wa Misiri marĩ ikundi matongoretio nĩ Musa na Harũni.
English: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, when they went out of the land of Egypt by their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.

Kikuyu: Musa nĩandĩkire matĩĩna ma rũgendo rwao o ta ũrĩa aathĩtwo nĩ Jehova. Maya nĩmo matĩĩna ma rũgendo rwao.
English: Moses wrote the starting points of their journeys by the commandment of Yahweh. These are their journeys according to their starting points.

Kikuyu: Andũ a Isiraeli moimagarire kuuma Ramesese mũthenya wa ikũmi na ĩtano mweri wa mbere, mũthenya ũrĩa warũmĩrĩire Bathaka. Makiumagara momĩrĩirie, makĩonagwo nĩ andũ othe a Misiri,
English: They traveled from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the next day after the Passover, the children of Israel went out with a high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians,

Kikuyu: arĩa maathikaga marigithathi mao mothe, marĩa Jehova ooragĩte gatagatĩ kao; nĩgũkorwo Jehova nĩatuĩrĩire ngai ciao ciira.
English: while the Egyptians were burying all their firstborn, whom Yahweh had struck among them. Yahweh also executed judgments on their gods.

Kikuyu: Andũ a Isiraeli moima Ramesese, maambire hema Sukothu.
English: The children of Israel traveled from Rameses, and encamped in Succoth.

Kikuyu: Moima Sukothu, magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao Ethamu, ndeere-inĩ cia werũ.
English: They traveled from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.

Kikuyu: Moima Ethamu, maacookire na thuutha magĩthiĩ Pi-Hahirothu, mwena wa irathĩro wa Baali- Zefoni, makĩamba hema ciao hakuhĩ na Migidoli.
English: They traveled from Etham, and turned back to Pihahiroth, which is before Baal Zephon, and they encamped before Migdol.

Kikuyu: Moima Pi-Hahirothu, magĩtuĩkanĩria iria-inĩ gatagatĩ, magĩkinya werũ-inĩ, na maarĩkia gũthiĩ rũgendo rwa mĩthenya ĩtatũ werũ-inĩ ũcio wa Ethamu, makĩamba hema ciao Mara.
English: They traveled from before Hahiroth, and crossed through the middle of the sea into the wilderness. They went three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham, and encamped in Marah.

Kikuyu: Moima Mara maathiire Elimu, kũrĩa kwarĩ na ithima ikũmi na igĩrĩ, na mĩtende mĩrongo mũgwanja, na makĩamba hema kuo.
English: They traveled from Marah, and came to Elim. In Elim, there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees, and they encamped there.

Kikuyu: Moima Elimu magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao hakuhĩ na Iria Itune.
English: They traveled from Elim, and encamped by the Red Sea.

Kikuyu: Moima Iria Itune, magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao werũ-inĩ wa Sini.
English: They traveled from the Red Sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.

Kikuyu: Moima werũ ũcio wa Sini, magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao Dofika.
English: They traveled from the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.

Kikuyu: Moima Dofika, magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao Alushu.
English: They traveled from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.

Kikuyu: Moima Alushu, magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao Refidimu, handũ hataarĩ na maaĩ ma kũnyuuo nĩ andũ.
English: They traveled from Alush, and encamped in Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.

Kikuyu: Moima Refidimu, magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao Werũ-inĩ wa Sinai.
English: They traveled from Rephidim, and encamped in the wilderness of Sinai.

Kikuyu: Moima kũu Werũ-inĩ wa Sinai, magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao Kibirothu-Hataava.
English: They traveled from the wilderness of Sinai, and encamped in Kibroth Hattaavah.

Kikuyu: Moima Kibirothu-Hataava magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao Hazerothu.
English: They traveled from Kibroth Hattaavah, and encamped in Hazeroth.

Kikuyu: Moima Hazerothu, magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao Rithima.
English: They traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in Rithmah.

Kikuyu: Moima Rithima, magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao Rimoni-Perezu.
English: They traveled from Rithmah, and encamped in Rimmon Perez.

Kikuyu: Moima Rimoni-Perezu magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao Libina.
English: They traveled from Rimmon Perez, and encamped in Libnah.

Kikuyu: Moima Libina, magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao Risa.
English: They traveled from Libnah, and encamped in Rissah.

Kikuyu: Moima Risa, magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao Kahelatha.
English: They traveled from Rissah, and encamped in Kehelathah.

Kikuyu: Moima Kahelatha, magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao Kĩrĩma-inĩ gĩa Sheferu.
English: They traveled from Kehelathah, and encamped in Mount Shepher.

Kikuyu: Moima Kĩrĩma-inĩ gĩa Sheferu, magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao Harada.
English: They traveled from Mount Shepher, and encamped in Haradah.

Kikuyu: Moima Harada, magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao Makelothu.
English: They traveled from Haradah, and encamped in Makheloth.

Kikuyu: Moima Makelothu magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao Tahathu.
English: They traveled from Makheloth, and encamped in Tahath.

Kikuyu: Moima Tahathu, magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao Tera.
English: They traveled from Tahath, and encamped in Terah.

Kikuyu: Moima Tera, magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao Mithika.
English: They traveled from Terah, and encamped in Mithkah.

Kikuyu: Moima Mithika, magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao Hashimona.
English: They traveled from Mithkah, and encamped in Hashmonah.

Kikuyu: Moima Hashimona, magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao Moserothu.
English: They traveled from Hashmonah, and encamped in Moseroth.

Kikuyu: Moima Moserothu, magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao Bene-Jaakani.
English: They traveled from Moseroth, and encamped in Bene Jaakan.

Kikuyu: Moima Bene-Jaakani, magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao Horu-Hagidigadi.
English: They traveled from Bene Jaakan, and encamped in Hor Haggidgad.

Kikuyu: Moima Horu-Hagidigadi, magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao Jotibatha.
English: They traveled from Hor Haggidgad, and encamped in Jotbathah.

Kikuyu: Moima Jotibatha, magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao Abirona.
English: They traveled from Jotbathah, and encamped in Abronah.

Kikuyu: Moima Abirona, magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao Ezioni-Geberi.
English: They traveled from Abronah, and encamped in Ezion Geber.

Kikuyu: Moima Ezioni-Geberi, magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao Kadeshi, Werũ-inĩ wa Zini.
English: They traveled from Ezion Geber, and encamped at Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.

Kikuyu: Moima Kadeshi, magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao Kĩrĩma-inĩ kĩa Horu, mũhaka-inĩ wa Edomu.
English: They traveled from Kadesh, and encamped in Mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.

Kikuyu: O ta ũrĩa aathĩtwo nĩ Jehova-rĩ, Harũni ũrĩa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai akĩambata Kĩrĩma kĩa Horu, harĩa aakuĩrĩire mũthenya wa mbere wa mweri wa gatano, mwaka-inĩ wa mĩrongo ĩna kuuma andũ a Isiraeli moima bũrũri wa Misiri.
English: Aaron the priest went up into Mount Hor at the commandment of Yahweh and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first day of the month.

Kikuyu: Harũni aarĩ na ũkũrũ wa mĩaka igana rĩa mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na ĩtatũ rĩrĩa aakuĩrĩire kũu Kĩrĩma kĩa Horu.
English: Aaron was one hundred twenty-three years old when he died in Mount Hor.

Kikuyu: Nake Aradi mũthamaki wa Kaanani ũrĩa watũũraga Negevu ya Kaanani, akĩigua atĩ andũ a Isiraeli maarĩ njĩra magĩthiĩ kuo.
English: The Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the South in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.

Kikuyu: Moima Kĩrĩma kĩa Horu, magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao Zalimona.
English: They traveled from Mount Hor, and encamped in Zalmonah.

Kikuyu: Moima Zalimona, magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao Punoni.
English: They traveled from Zalmonah, and encamped in Punon.

Kikuyu: Moima Punoni, magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao Obothu.
English: They traveled from Punon, and encamped in Oboth.

Kikuyu: Moima Obothu, magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao Iye-Abarimu, mũhaka-inĩ wa Moabi.
English: They traveled from Oboth, and encamped in Iye Abarim, in the border of Moab.

Kikuyu: Moima Iyimu, magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao Diboni-Gadi.
English: They traveled from Iyim, and encamped in Dibon Gad.

Kikuyu: Moima Diboni-Gadi, magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao Alimoni-Dibilathaimu.
English: They traveled from Dibon Gad, and encamped in Almon Diblathaim.

Kikuyu: Moima Alimoni-Dibilathaimu, magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao irĩma-inĩ cia Abarimu hakuhĩ na Nebo.
English: They traveled from Almon Diblathaim, and encamped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.

Kikuyu: Moima irĩma-inĩ cia Abarimu, magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao werũ-inĩ wa Moabi hũgũrũrũ-inĩ cia Rũũĩ rwa Jorodani mũrĩmo ũrĩa ũngĩ wa Jeriko.
English: They traveled from the mountains of Abarim, and encamped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

Kikuyu: Maambire hema hũgũrũrũ-inĩ cia Rũũĩ rwa Jorodani kuuma Bethi-Jeshimothu nginya Abeli-Shitimu, kũu werũ-inĩ wa Moabi.
English: They encamped by the Jordan, from Beth Jeshimoth even to Abel Shittim in the plains of Moab.

Kikuyu: Kũu werũ-inĩ wa Moabi hũgũrũrũ-inĩ cia Rũũĩ rwa Jorodani mũrĩmo ũrĩa ũngĩ wa Jeriko, nĩkuo Jehova erĩire Musa atĩrĩ,
English: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

Kikuyu: “Arĩria andũ a Isiraeli, na ũmeere atĩrĩ: ‘Rĩrĩa mũkaaringa Rũũĩ rwa Jorodani mũtoonye Kaanani-rĩ,
English: Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, “When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

Kikuyu: mũkaaingata andũ arĩa othe matũũraga bũrũri ũcio, mehere mbere yanyu. Mũkaananga mĩhianano yao yothe ĩrĩa mĩicũhie, na mĩhianano yao ĩrĩa ya gũtwekio, o na mũmomore mahooero mao mothe ma kũndũ kũrĩa gũtũũgĩru.
English: then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, destroy all their stone idols, destroy all their molten images, and demolish all their high places.

Kikuyu: Mwĩnyiitĩrei bũrũri ũcio ũtuĩke wanyu na mũtũũre kuo, nĩgũkorwo nĩ ndĩmũheete bũrũri ũcio ũtuĩke wanyu.
English: You shall take possession of the land, and dwell therein; for I have given the land to you to possess it.

Kikuyu: Mũkaagayania bũrũri ũcio na ũndũ wa kũũcukĩra mĩtĩ, kũringana na mĩhĩrĩga yanyu. Kũrĩ gĩkundi kĩnene mũheane igai inene, na gĩkundi kĩnini mũkĩhe igai inini. Kĩrĩa gĩkaamagũĩra na ũndũ wa gũcuuka mĩtĩ nĩkĩo gĩgaatuĩka kĩao. Nĩmũgakũgayania kũringana na mĩhĩrĩga ya maithe manyu ma tene.
English: You shall inherit the land by lot according to your families; to the larger groups you shall give a larger inheritance, and to the smaller you shall give a smaller inheritance. Wherever the lot falls to any man, that shall be his. You shall inherit according to the tribes of your fathers.

Kikuyu: “ ‘No mũngĩkaaga kũingata atũũri a bũrũri ũcio-rĩ, arĩa mũgeetĩkĩria matigwo magaatuĩka ngaracũ cia kũmũtũraga maitho, o na matuĩke mĩigua ya kũmũtheecaga mbaru. Nao nĩmakamũthĩĩ- nagia kũu bũrũri ũcio mũgaatũũra.
